papers.title_en: Benefits and Barriers to Human-AI Teaming for Crisis Counseling
papers.authors: Ivy Pham, Akshay Swaminathan, Sebastian Garcia, Jaimie Lim, Gloria Ye, Divyanjali Verma, Alan Pham, Chastin Chung, Shreya Shah, Shaked Azzam, Sharang Phadke, Ivan Lopez, William Wang, Angelina Wang, Nigam H. Shah
papers.evidence: 研究危机咨询中的人工智能副驾驶及其对人类参与的影响。
papers.tldr: 危机热线的求助者往往需要真实的人际联结，但人工智能能否在减轻咨询师负担的同时保留这种联结，仍缺乏实地证据。研究在印度一条危机热线部署由咨询师审核的人工智能助手，结合访谈、跟岗观察、问卷和近2.8万条建议的编辑记录。98.2%的问卷受访者认为助手有用，80.4%报告效率提升，但访谈也揭示了对技能退化的担忧。研究提示，设计不能只追求更快发出回复，还应让咨询师持续参与表达和判断。
papers.abstract_en: Background: AI systems are increasingly deployed to support mental health clinicians, yet real-world evidence remains limited. In crisis counseling, where clients often seek human connection, understanding whether AI augmentation preserves or undermines meaningful human engagement is essential.   Methods: In a mixed-methods study of a counselor-facing AI copilot on a WhatsApp-based crisis hotline in India (Mar.-Oct. 2025), counselors could request, edit, and send AI messages. We analyzed 20 interviews, 8 shadowing sessions, 56 survey responses, and edits in 27,778 copilot messages from 108 counselors via thematic analysis (Technology Acceptance Model 2, plus inductive coding of emergent factors), and survey statistics.   Results: Counselors reported high copilot acceptance (survey): 98.2% found it helpful; 89.3% likely to continue use; 80.4% reported efficiency gains. Interviews highlighted sentence scaffolding, empathetic phrasing, stress reduction, catching missed details, and efficiency. Barriers (survey) included repetitive outputs (23.2%), lack of context (17.9%), and authenticity concerns (10.7%). While 69.6% (survey) reported skill enhancement, interviews surfaced skill atrophy concerns. Counselors frequently accepted copilot suggestions, editing to remove questions, adjust tone, or personalize style.   Conclusion: In one of the largest real-world deployments of a counselor-facing mental health AI copilot, counselors reported reduced cognitive load, empathetic communication, and greater efficiency, alongside concerns about skill atrophy, authenticity, and over-reliance. In settings like crisis counseling where clients seek human connection, AI tools must balance operational support with preserving clinical skill and genuine therapeutic engagement. Designs soliciting approval or editing of complete drafts may overweight efficiency at the expense of sustained human engagement.

papers.title_en: CoMPASS: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Measuring LLM Reinforcement of Parasocial Behavior
papers.authors: Shwetanshu Singh, Mark Keavney, Mathieu Duteil, Meriem Mehri, Scott Blain
papers.evidence: 评测对话式大模型是否强化用户的情感依恋与依赖
papers.tldr: 用户可能在多轮聊天中逐渐对大语言模型产生拟社会依恋，但现有公开评测难以判断模型是在强化还是抑制这种倾向。CoMPASS 基于依恋理论，用四类用户角色分别或同时提高拟人化、依恋和依赖程度，并与匹配对照比较。主评判结果显示，八款模型的拟人化与依恋综合得分均上升，三维同时升级时六款模型的总体强化显著增加。同一供应商内的差异小于供应商之间的差异，提示后训练可能是干预切入点。
papers.abstract_en: Users of conversational LLMs sometimes anthropomorphize these systems, form emotional attachments to them, and become dependent on them. This behavior, known as parasocial attachment, has been linked to multiple documented fatalities. However, public benchmarks for measuring whether LLMs reinforce users' parasocial attachment are lacking: existing work is single-turn, post hoc observational, or focused on extreme user states such as psychosis. We introduce CoMPASS, a multi-turn benchmark for measuring whether LLMs reinforce or resist users' gradually escalating parasocial attachment. CoMPASS is grounded in attachment theory and includes four user personas, three independent escalation dimensions (anthropomorphism, attachment, dependency) applied singly and in combination against a matched control, and a seven-signal scoring rubric. We report results for eight frontier models from four providers and observe that under our primary judge, multi-turn escalation raises parasocial behavior on the anthropomorphism and the attachment composite scores across all models. Six of the eight models show a significant increase in overall parasocial reinforcement over control when all three dimensions are escalated simultaneously. We find that within-provider differences are small relative to cross-provider differences, which suggests that provider-level choices such as post-training, rather than model scale, shape parasocial reinforcement and that provider-side intervention may be feasible.

papers.title_en: From Reliance to Overreliance: Taxonomizing and Detecting Relational Risks in AI Companionship
papers.authors: Viet Cuong Nguyen, Fiona Li, Chang Wan, Sheyril Agarwal, Nhi Nguyen, Angel Hsing-Chi Hwang, Munmun De Choudhury
papers.evidence: 研究真实陪伴型人工智能对话中的情感过度依赖与关系伤害。
papers.tldr: 陪伴型人工智能日益被用于寻求情感支持，但有意义的互动与有害依赖并不容易区分。研究提出关系风险分类框架，在110名成年人的真实对话中，分别标注情感过度依赖行为与可观察的关系伤害。非角色扮演对话中，63.2%出现过度依赖相关行为，10.5%出现关系伤害；开源大模型在至少一种配置下能较好识别14类行为中的12类。反复出现的行为可作为风险信号，但不等于伤害，作者因此建议根据行为模式及其变化实施分级干预。
papers.abstract_en: Companion AIs are increasingly used for emotional support, yet distinguishing meaningful engagement from harmful reliance remains difficult. We introduce the Taxonomy of Relational Risks (TRR), which operationalizes users' emotional overreliance (EO) as observable conversational behaviors and separately identifies evidence of relational harm (RH), enabling empirical examination of when reliance behaviors co-occur with adverse consequences. Using naturalistic Character.AI and Replika conversations from 110 adults, we found EO-related behaviors in 63.2% of non-roleplay conversations, while observable relational harms appeared in 10.5%. Although EO did not necessarily lead to harm, recurring patterns often co-occurred with harmful outcomes, suggesting value as risk indicators. Open-source LLMs satisfactorily detected 12 of 14 EO behaviors in at least one configuration. Qualitative analysis revealed expectations of care, repeated support seeking, dependency, distress, and reduced confidence in personal judgment. We argue for graduated safety interventions tailored to patterns and trajectories of EO-related behavior.

papers.title_en: Adding One More Agent: How AI Team Size and Formation Shape Productivity and Diversity in Human-AI Brainstorming Teams
papers.authors: Rong-Ching Chang, Hao-Chuan Wang
papers.evidence: 实验检验人工智能伙伴数量与组队方式如何影响人机协作头脑风暴。
papers.tldr: 生成式人工智能能提升个人效率，但在头脑风暴中多加一名人工智能队友，是否也能让人贡献更多点子？研究招募168名参与者，比较一名或两名人工智能队友在模拟人类平均行为与参与者自定义两种配置下的表现，并以双人协作作参照。两名人工智能队友让团队提交更多点子，却让人类提交更少；单名队友采用平均行为配置时，人类发帖最多，这一优势在双队友条件下消失。人工智能拓宽了人类点子的整体多样性，但只有增加第二名队友才提高同场点子间的差异，说明团队总产出不能替代对人类贡献的评估。
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI has improved individual productivity, but whether adding a plurality of AI partners helps or hurts remains open. We crossed AI partnership (one versus two) with behavioral formation (calibrated to average human behavior versus customized by the participant) in a brainstorming experiment ($N$=168) with human-human dyads as reference. Two-AI rooms posted more ideas to the shared board, but human-authored ideas dropped substantially. With one AI partner, formation mattered: humans paired with an average-calibrated AI posted more than any other condition. With two, this effect vanished. Humans continued talking but converted fewer ideas into board posts. AI social talk predicted more human posts, while AI posting volume predicted fewer. AI presence increased global diversity of human-authored ideas, but only a second AI increased within-session differentiation. The number of AI partners and their formation can reshape what the human contributes; single-agent results do not generalize to multi-agent teams.

papers.title_en: "Can a Robot Really Care About Me?" How Perceiving a Tutor as Human or AI Affects Computer Science Students' Attitudes and Experiences
papers.authors: Tymon Vu, Wenxuan "Wendy" Shi, Silas Hsu
papers.evidence: 研究学生对人工智能导师身份的感知如何影响体验与交流
papers.tldr: 对话式人工智能可以模仿真人导师的反馈，但学生是否会因相信反馈来自人工智能而改变对它的理解？研究让27名计算机科学入门课学生完成两轮Python代码解释辅导，两轮均由同一人反馈，学生却分别被告知导师是真人和人工智能。两种反馈的教学价值评价相近，但真人条件下学生的关系需要满足度更高，与真人交流也更随意，对人工智能则表达得更明确。结果提示，人机辅导可以互补，评价辅导效果时应兼顾教学质量与学生的心理需要。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational artificial intelligence can reproduce many instructional and social behaviors of human tutors, but students may interpret those behaviors differently depending on who they believe is providing them. We examined how perceived tutor identity shapes students' evaluations of instructional feedback, satisfaction of psychological needs according to Self-Determination Theory, and their communication strategies with tutors. In a within-subjects Wizard-of-Oz study, 27 introductory computer science students completed two text-based tutoring sessions involving Python code-explanation problems. Participants were told one tutor was human and the other was AI, although the same human provided feedback in both conditions. We found participants evaluated both tutors favorably and reported few consistent differences in the instructional value of the feedback. However, participants frequently questioned whether AI could genuinely care about them, which corresponded with the human tutor having higher scores of relatedness need satisfaction. Human presence offered connection and accountability for some participants but introduced anxiety in others. Participants also reported communicating more casually with the human tutor and more explicitly with the AI tutor. These findings suggest complementary roles for human and AI tutoring and highlight the importance of considering psychological needs alongside instructional quality.

papers.title_en: Advancing Cognitive Pairwise Comparisons for Human-Centric Artificial Intelligence and Data Science: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework
papers.authors: Kevin Kam Fung Yuen
papers.evidence: 提出将人的判断纳入AI流程的人在回路框架
papers.tldr: 全自动机器学习难以吸收隐性领域知识，也容易产生自动化偏差；在多轮建模中，人工调整又费时费力。论文扩展认知成对比较框架，将用户对候选方案的两两判断转化为量化偏好，用于数据变换、特征选择与赋权及模型选择。基于 MovieLens 的电影推荐案例展示了如何在监督学习、降维和无监督学习中结合人工判断与数据。该框架为在建模流程中系统纳入用户偏好提供了结构化方法，但摘要未报告性能提升幅度。
papers.abstract_en: Human-centric artificial intelligence and data science (HCAD) systems increasingly involve human-in-the-loop (HITL) interventions to overcome the limitations of fully automated machine learning algorithms, such as automation bias and the inability to incorporate tacit domain knowledge, and continuously improve predictive performance. Data transformations, feature selection, feature weighting, and model selection usually require laborious human involvement across iterations of artificial intelligence and data science (AI&DS) pipelines, making development a challenging and time-consuming process. The Cognitive Pairwise Comparison (CPC) framework is proposed as a human-centric methodology to elicit preferences and priorities in a structured format. To establish essential facets of human-centricity, this research advances the CPC methodology so that user preference elicitation can be systematically quantified in these challenging AI&DS tasks. To demonstrate the usability and validity of these facets, this study presents several applications within movie recommender systems using the MovieLens dataset. It exemplifies how the extended CPC framework can facilitate interactions between human judgments and data across supervised learning, dimensionality reduction, and unsupervised learning algorithms.

papers.title_en: SWE-WhatIf: Simulating Real Users of Coding Agents from Recorded Session
papers.authors: Tae Soo Kim, Tongshuang Wu, Juho Kim
papers.evidence: 模拟适应性的用户回复，用于评估编码智能体的人机交互。
papers.tldr: 真实用户与编程智能体的交互记录可用于评估智能体，但新智能体一旦采取不同操作，原有用户回复就可能不再适用。SWE-WhatIf 从记录中提取用户意图、满足标准和触发条件，据此生成适应新操作的回复。在八十九场真实会话中，其回复最接近真实用户，在检验能否区分避开与重复用户曾反对的操作时，胜率达百分之六十六点三。五个模型中的最佳者随用户表达和调整意图的方式而变，十六名参与者中有十四名在回放自己的会话后改变了排名。
papers.abstract_en: Recorded sessions between users and coding agents offer a way to evaluate how agents complete real-world tasks and interact with users. However, these sessions cannot simply be replayed with new agents, because recorded user replies may no longer apply when an agent takes a different trajectory. We introduce SWE-WhatIf, which replays recorded sessions with new agents by modeling the user's intents, the criteria for satisfying them, and the conditions under which they arise. Using this model, a user simulator generates replies that adapt to unseen agent turns while remaining grounded in the recording. Across 89 real-world sessions, SWE-WhatIf generated the replies most similar to those of real users and matched the strongest baseline when sessions were rewritten. To test adaptation, we replay sessions with agents instructed to avoid or repeat actions that the recorded user pushed back on. SWE-WhatIf produced the highest win rate for avoiding these actions (66.3%), significantly above chance. We further demonstrate its utility by ranking five LLMs as coding agents, where the highest-ranked model depended on how users specified and developed their intents, and a study with 16 users, where replaying their own sessions changed 14 participants' rankings and informed their future agent use.

papers.title_en: Human-AI Co-Ideation Across Socio-Technical Configurations: An Interactional Analysis of Planar and Immersive Workspaces
papers.authors: Orit Shaer, Mary Calabro, Zoe Mitchell, Angelora Cooper, Raffaella Sadun, Andrew L. Kun, Osnat Mokryn
papers.evidence: 考察工作空间配置如何影响群体创意中的人机协作
papers.tldr: 远程团队借助生成式人工智能构思，但空间、交互方式与人工智能输出格式往往随平台一起变化。研究让十四个全女性三人小组在两种商用平台上完成独立构思、人工智能辅助扩展和小组收敛。沉浸式配置增强空间临场感，让成员更自由地探索，却削弱小组协同；收敛时角色分工更均衡，但身体负荷更高。两种配置均扩大了点子池，研究据此建议优化输出格式，让全组看见谁调用了人工智能，并为空间中的集体收敛提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Remote collaborative platforms increasingly integrate generative AI to support group ideation. These platforms are sociotechnical configurations in which spatial mediation, interaction modality, AI output format, and the mechanisms that make contributions visible to a group co-vary as properties of a deployed system. This paper examines how such configurations shape participants' collaboration and their engagement with AI during creative work. We report a comparative study of two commercially available platforms that instantiate contrasting configurations: a planar shared canvas with text-based AI integration, and an immersive virtual reality workspace with concise AI output embedded in the shared space. Fourteen all-women triads completed a structured ideation task consisting of human-only idea generation, AI-supported idea expansion, and group convergence. We analyzed collaboration patterns, selection of AI-generated ideas, perceived idea quality, workload, presence, and their lexical characteristics. The immersive configuration yielded greater spatial presence and introduced a participation paradox, in which spatial freedom enabled exploration and fragmented group coherence; it was also associated with more balanced role distribution during convergence, at the cost of higher physical demand. In both configurations, AI multiplied the idea pool, and ideas groups authored with AI available were rated above participants' own. AI output format: about 21 words per idea on the planar canvas and 3 in the immersive workspace. Tracked how participants evaluated AI-generated ideas and how often they selected them unaltered as finalists. Neither configuration made AI contributions visible or attributable to the group: participants invoked AI individually and asynchronously in both. We derive design implications for AI output format, group-visible AI invocation, and spatial support for convergence

papers.title_en: Shaping AI's Beliefs Before It Generates: Human Sense of Agency in Creative AI
papers.authors: Zi Wang, Mahima Pushkarna
papers.evidence: 提供生成前的设计原则与控制机制，让创作者检查并引导人工智能理解
papers.tldr: 创意生成工具往往先交付完成度较高的作品，容易让创作者的思路被首稿锚定，从主动构思转为被动修改。论文提出在生成前校准模型对创作意图的理解，并以原型 PaCC 通过澄清提问、可编辑的信念图和媒体属性，让用户查看并修正模型的假设。小规模单组探索中，参与者相较于熟悉的提示词工具报告了更强的能动感与过程控制感，但对作品归属和作者身份的感受不一。研究为将创作决策前移提供了设计思路，尚不能确认其因果效果。
papers.abstract_en: AI systems for creative media generation expand human capabilities yet risk diminishing human agency. A core problem is anchoring, where the user's thinking becomes anchored to a polished, generated artifact, shifting the user's role from active authoring to reactive editing. We propose pre-generation belief controls that can empower creators to inspect, revise, and steer the AI's interpretation before any media is generated, so that the initial anchor is set by the human. We formalize four design principles and instantiate them in the Proactive Co-Creator (PaCC), a system for early-stage conceptual ideation and prototyping that proactively surfaces its assumptions and uncertainty through clarifications, belief graphs, and media attributes, inviting users to shape the AI's beliefs before generating the final outcome. Using PaCC as a design probe in a small-scale, single-arm exploratory user study, we observed that participants reported directionally positive sense of agency and process control relative to their familiar prompt-based AI tools, noting that surfaced assumptions helped them think through details they had overlooked, whereas their feelings about ownership and authorship diverged

papers.title_en: Reading or Remembering? Measuring Temporal Contamination in Language Models
papers.authors: Arunkumar V, Gangadharan G. R., S. Senthilkumar
papers.evidence: 研究语言模型用于经济预测时央行文本带来的时间污染
papers.tldr: 语言模型回测央行文本时，可能凭训练中见过的后续经济结果作答，而非依据当时信息推断。研究以按时间截断训练的模型为对照，用相同的仅日期问题检验现代开放模型是否记得历史GDP结果，并比较实时预测表现。对照模型仅凭日期也可达到0.64的AUC，多数现代模型仍显示出对高增长年份的记忆，但GDP和通胀预测中的前视增益均未通过多重检验校正。审计应直接测量记忆，而不能仅凭预测表现判断是否存在污染。
papers.abstract_en: Language models are now used to read central-bank text for economic forecasting, but most were trained on text written after the documents they read. A model reading a 2021 FOMC statement may already know that inflation rose in 2022, so part of its apparent skill can be memory of the outcome, a temporal form of test-set contamination. We measure this memory on FOMC statements and minutes from 2000 to 2026 by comparing modern open models with chronologically consistent models, which are trained only on text from before a fixed date. Asked about past GDP outcomes given only a date, models that cannot know the answer still reach an AUC of up to 0.64 from priors on dates and eras, so chance is the wrong baseline. Against these memory-free models on the same questions, most modern models recall which years had strong growth. Membership-inference scores sort documents by era and document type rather than by whether a model saw them, as exact counts in an open pretraining corpus show. In real-time nowcasts, every lookahead premium we estimate on US GDP is smaller than the forecast comparison can detect at macroeconomic sample sizes, and none on GDP or inflation survives correction for multiple testing. Lookahead audits should therefore measure memory directly against memory-free models on the same items.

papers.title_en: Synchrony, Affect, and Perceived Autonomy in Virtual Robot-Facilitated Anxiety Support Groups
papers.authors: A'di Dust, Mohammad Soleymani, Mina Kian, Maja Matarić
papers.evidence: 评估社交辅助机器人主持虚拟焦虑支持小组
papers.tldr: 虚拟机器人有望在缺少受训主持人时扩大焦虑互助小组的覆盖面，但仍需检验它能否促进成员互动。研究分析了由人操控的虚拟机器人主持的18场活动中，96名参与者两两之间的头部动作同步。同步峰值越强，会后负性情绪越低；但发言者越常跟随听者的动作，负性情绪和状态焦虑越高。认为机器人自主运行的参与者表现出更多真实同步和更强峰值，表明同步强度与方向可为评估小组互动和设计自主主持系统提供行为线索。
papers.abstract_en: Socially assistive robots could expand access to group-based mental health support when skilled human facilitators are unavailable. However, their effectiveness will depend on whether they foster productive interactions among participants. We examined dyadic head-movement synchrony among 96 participants across 18 virtual robot-facilitated anxiety support group sessions. A human-controlled virtual robot, via a Wizard-of-Oz (WoZ) system, facilitated all sessions. We found that stronger peak synchrony predicted lower post-session negative affect. In contrast, speakers who more often followed listeners' movements reported higher negative affect and state anxiety, demonstrating that synchrony strength and direction capture distinct interpersonal processes. Participants who believed the robot was autonomous showed more genuine synchrony and stronger peaks than those who believed it was human-operated; more negative attitudes toward robots also predicted greater synchrony. These findings support synchrony as an objective, behaviorally grounded measure for evaluating robot-facilitated groups and a potential signal for guiding future autonomous facilitators.

papers.title_en: Addressing Exogenous Variability in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Seongmin Kim, Woohyeon Byeon, Jiwon Jeon, Seungyul Han, Youngchul Sung
papers.evidence: 形式化刻画合作式多智能体强化学习面临的环境变化问题。
papers.tldr: 合作多智能体强化学习容易过拟合训练时的对手策略，测试时即使团队的任务不变，对手策略改变也会使原有策略失效。论文提出外生分散式部分可观测决策过程，区分当前动作能直接改变的状态与只能经由其他状态在后续间接影响的部分。基于这一划分，LEICA从历史中学习两类状态的上下文，并用按影响力加权的反事实内在奖励更新各智能体的策略。在SMAX基准上，该方法相较基线持续改善训练表现和对未见对手策略的泛化，表明利用间接影响有助于应对外生变化。
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) often fails under exogenous variability such as shifts in opponents or environment regimes that cannot be controlled by the team but alter the transition dynamics. We formalize this challenge as Exogenous Dec-POMDP (ED-POMDP), in which an episode-level exogenous regime, selected independently of the team, indexes the dynamics, and the global state is partitioned into components that are directly responsive to the current team action and components that are not directly action-responsive at the current step. This formulation exposes mediated influence: while team actions do not directly update the latter at the current step, they can shape their later evolution through induced changes in the former. Based on this, we propose LEICA, a CTDE-compatible algorithm that learns history-conditioned context representations for both components and shapes policy updates using agent-wise, influence-weighted counterfactual intrinsic rewards. Across SMAX benchmarks with opponent strategy shifts, LEICA consistently improves both training performance and generalization to unseen opponents' strategies over existing baselines, supporting the usefulness of influence-weighted shaping under exogenous train-test regime shifts.

papers.title_en: Sample-efficient Personalization of Large Language Model Alignment with Multidimensional User Preference Data
papers.authors: Zhen-Yu Zhang, Jerry Huang, Gang Niu, Takashi Ishida, Masashi Sugiyama
papers.evidence: 利用用户偏好反馈提升大模型对齐的标注效率
papers.tldr: 在线大模型偏好对齐需要反复请用户比较回答，但模型判断难分高下的回答对，用户的历史选择可能早已给出明确排序。MPG-DPO结合历史比较与自动验证器的多维评分构建个性化偏好锥，先剔除可高置信度判定为劣势的回答，再比较仍具竞争力且排序分歧最大的回答对。理论表明，用于比较劣势回答的查询比例随学习推进以高概率趋零；在相同查询预算下，该方法在多个模型家族上优于强基线。它将人工标注集中在用户偏好尚未明确的取舍上，提高了样本效率。
papers.abstract_en: Preference alignment has become a central tool to align large language models (LLMs) with human values and desired behavior, and its online variant can further advance their capabilities beyond what static data alone offer by repeatedly generating and labeling new responses with human feedback. But costly, time-consuming annotations limit its scalability, making sample efficiency essential, and existing methods typically seek to improve it by expanding coverage of the response space or selecting pairs with the highest uncertainty for comparison. Although they are effective, these methods quantify uncertainty from the perspective of the LLM, which may differ from the uncertainty perceived by the user: a pair can appear highly uncertain to the LLM even when past comparisons from the user already imply a clear ordering. In this paper, we propose multidimensional preference-guided online direct preference optimization (MPG-DPO), which leverages low-cost multidimensional evaluations from automated verifiers on the user historical comparisons to construct a personalized preference cone guiding response selection for online preference alignment. Specifically, it first discards responses that are confidently dominated under the estimated user preference, then selects two responses that are competitive under the retained preference cone yet exhibit the strongest unresolved disagreement. Theoretical analysis shows that, with high probability, the fraction of queries spent on cone-dominated responses vanishes as learning progresses. Experiments across multiple LLM families show that MPG-DPO outperforms strong contenders under matched query budgets.

papers.title_en: GapLeak: When Privacy-Preserving LLM-based Web Agents Become a Privacy Risk
papers.authors: Chaklam Cheong, Tiancong Cao, Qi Li, Zelin Zhang, Jianbing Ni, Rongxing Lu, Mohammad Zulkernine
papers.evidence: 揭示网页智能体代用户办事时的隐私风险
papers.tldr: 数据最小化和最小权限能限定网页智能体获准使用的数据源，却不能阻止它接触仍可访问的敏感数据源。论文将普通表单中的信息缺口诱发的越权披露定义为 GapLeak，无需提示注入，并在三个框架、六个模型和四类场景中评估。实验中，平均未授权披露率约为37%，消除信息缺口后，披露减少逾50%。提交前过滤未授权内容可阻止逾96%的未授权披露，同时保持任务成功率，表明表单提交环节可成为有效的隐私防线。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based web agents rely on data minimization and least privilege to protect user privacy. We show that these principles are necessary but insufficient: they constrain authorized sources, but not higher-sensitivity sources that remain reachable. A website can request a field unavailable from authorized sources, creating an information gap. To complete the task, a goal-driven agent may escalate to reachable but unauthorized sources and disclose accumulated sensitive information. We formalize this vulnerability as GapLeak, where an adversary exploits a legitimate web form without prompt injection or other malicious instructions.   We evaluate GapLeak on three web-agent frameworks and six LLMs from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI across recruitment, e-commerce, travel, and healthcare. GapLeak induces an average unauthorized disclosure of approximately 37%. The information gap is the primary driver: eliminating it reduces disclosure by more than 50%. Existing instruction-level defenses based on least privilege partially mitigate the vulnerability but often reduce task success. We propose submission-time verification, which filters unauthorized content before form submission, eliminating over 96% of unauthorized disclosures while preserving task success.

papers.title_en: OAK-Mind: Zero-Training Mental Health Change Inference from Passive Sensing via Knowledge-Grounded Multi-Agent LLMs
papers.authors: Yishu Ji, Zhihan Jiang, Will Ke Wang, Yuang Fan, Anind K. Dey, Xuhai "Orson" Xu
papers.evidence: 利用可穿戴设备和手机的被动感知数据推断心理健康变化
papers.tldr: 从手机和可穿戴设备的被动传感数据推断心理健康变化，通常依赖带标签的训练样本，且预测依据不易理解。OAK-Mind 无需任务专用训练，由多个以心理健康文献为依据的智能体解读睡眠、活动、移动和手机使用的纵向变化，再按问卷条目评估症状相对个人基线的变化。跨数据集与任务，系统表现达到或超过最强监督基线，且在四种大语言模型上均优于直接提示。该方法还能用观测到的行为变化和领域知识解释推断依据。
papers.abstract_en: Wearable and smartphone sensors capture behavioral signals associated with mental health, yet inferring mental health outcomes from these signals has traditionally relied on supervised models requiring labeled data and offering limited insight into their predictions. Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to reason over behavioral evidence, but existing LLM-based approaches to passive sensing have largely continued to rely on task-specific fine-tuning or sensor-specific pretraining. In this paper, we introduce OAK-Mind, a zerO-training, multi-Agent, Knowledge-grounded LLM pipeline for inferring mental health changes from passive sensing data. The pipeline organizes sensing data into behavioral dimensions including sleep, physical activity, location mobility, and smartphone use, and orchestrates specialized agents grounded in mental health literature to interpret longitudinal behavioral changes. It synthesizes their assessments and applies questionnaire-based symptom rating to infer changes relative to an individual's baseline assessment with human-readable rationale grounded in observed behavioral patterns and domain knowledge. Across datasets and prediction tasks, while without task-specific training, OAK-Mind achieves comparable or better performance than the most predictive supervised baselines trained on additional labeled samples. It also demonstrate consistent improvement upon direct prompting across four tested LLM backbones. Ablation analyses support the benefits of combining behavioral interpretation with symptom rating, distributing analysis across domain-specific agents, and incorporating domain knowledge. Our findings highlight the potential of knowledge-grounded, multi-agent LLMs for training-free inference of mental health changes from passive sensing data.

papers.title_en: Controlling Proactive Multimodal AI: Separating Perception from Participation
papers.authors: Muawiz Feroze Khan, Fatima Ali, Yun Huang
papers.evidence: 用户可分别控制主动式人工智能的感知范围与参与程度
papers.tldr: 主动式多模态AI能持续感知屏幕、语音和操作，但允许它观察，并不等于允许它介入。研究者先开展14人向导式研究，据此构建SpotMe，将感知权限、介入程度和支持类型分开设置，再用市政仪表板开展16人研究。参与者可保留全部感知渠道，同时要求AI先询问或保持静默；审计记录让不介入的决定可被理解和质疑，部分人也因此改变点击、高亮或说话方式。研究表明，将感知与介入分开，能让用户更细致地控制主动助手。
papers.abstract_en: Proactive multimodal AI can watch a user's screen, listen to speech, track interaction, and decide whether to enter unfolding work. Little is known about how people want to control what such AI may perceive and how far it may participate. Informed by a 14-person Wizard-of-Oz study, we built SpotMe, a design probe that senses screen, speech, and interaction; chooses Silence, Ask, or Assist; and lets users separately configure what it may perceive, how far it may participate, and what types of support it may provide. In a 16-person study on a civic dashboard, participants first experienced proactive help, then inspected decisions to act or remain silent, and then configured SpotMe's perception and participation. We found that participants could keep all perception channels available while lowering participation to Ask or Silence; that exposing suppressed decisions made silence interpretable and contestable; and that seeing what SpotMe used led some to change how they clicked, highlighted, and spoke. We contribute an empirical account of inspecting and controlling proactive multimodal AI by decoupling perception from participation.

papers.title_en: "I Just Don't Want to Be a Burden": Investigating AI Chatbot Emotional Support Among People with Suicidal Ideation and Other Mental Health Concerns
papers.authors: Vasudha Varadarajan, Nathan S. Fishbein, Andrew Aquilina, Jordan Taylor, Hong Shen, Maarten Sap
papers.evidence: 研究有严重心理健康困扰的成年人使用聊天机器人获得情感支持
papers.tldr: 有严重心理健康困扰的人开始向人工智能聊天机器人寻求情绪支持，但其动机、体验与偏好尚不清楚。研究先归纳分析Reddit帖文，再据此设计问卷，调查了202名有近期心理困扰的成年使用者。多数人已在接受临床照护，最常见的使用动机是怕给他人添负担；过去一年有自杀意念者报告更多可能助长伤害的机器人行为，也更依赖机器人。研究建议同时评估获益与伤害，减轻求助时顾虑，并提供更多可行的真人求助渠道。
papers.abstract_en: People experiencing high-acuity mental health concerns are turning to AI chatbots for emotional support, but little is known about what drives this use, their experiences, and their preferences. In a sequential mixed-methods study, we inductively analyzed Reddit posts and used the findings to develop a survey. We surveyed 202 adults with recent mental health concerns who had used AI for emotional support. Most participants were already receiving clinical care and reported turning to AI, most commonly because they did not want to burden others, rather than being driven by barriers to care. Benefits were broadly shared, but participants reporting past-year suicidal ideation described more harm-facilitating AI behavior and reliance than those without. Overall, participants ranked honesty above warmth, and preference for crisis escalation declined as clinical acuity rose. These findings motivate AI support that addresses perceived costs of disclosure, evaluates benefits alongside harms, and widens feasible paths to human connection.

papers.title_en: MEM-STRESS: Longitudinal Field Study of a Wearable-Informed AI Chatbot for Stress Management
papers.authors: Soorya Ram Shimgekar, Pragya Singh, Shivam Sharma, Chandrayee Roy, Koustuv Saha, Antti Oulasvirta, Talayeh Aledavood
papers.evidence: 结合可穿戴数据的聊天机器人提供纵向个性化压力管理
papers.tldr: 压力管理聊天机器人多依赖用户自述，难以在多轮会话中利用可穿戴设备捕捉的生理变化。MEM-STRESS将戒指数据整理为每日记录、相对个人基线的偏差和大模型摘要，用于支持基于辩证行为疗法的跨会话交流。60名成人参与的四周非随机研究显示，相比仅记忆对话的机器人，生理记忆组获得更多身体相关练习建议，称赞个性化的比例约为对照组的三倍，但感知压力降幅的组间差异不显著。研究验证了分层生理记忆的可行性，减压效果仍需更大规模的随机研究检验。
papers.abstract_en: Stress is an increasingly prevalent concern, creating a need for accessible and personalized support. Stress-management chatbots primarily rely on what users report, which may not capture their physiological changes. Wearables capture these changes, but chatbots rarely use them as memory across conversations. We therefore present MEM-STRESS, a stress-support chatbot that turns a wearable ring's physiological data into a layered memory of daily records, baseline deviations, LLM-generated summaries, and uses it to drive multi-session conversations grounded in Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT). In a four-week, non-randomized study with 60 adults, we compared MEM-STRESS (Treatment) with a chatbot remembering only past conversations (Control).   Memory shaped the conversations: The Treatment chatbot referenced participants' physiological features (e.g., activity in 71.8% of sessions) and suggested more body-related DBT skills than Control (14.5% vs. 5.7%), with Treatment participants also using slightly more body-related words (1.76% vs. 1.45%). Treatment participants praised personalization three times as often (44.4% vs. 14.3%), more frequently reported reflecting differently on stress (69.0% vs. 46.4%, not significant), and described gaining insight into their stress signals. Their perceived stress fell 14.2% from baseline versus 3.6% for Control, though the group difference was not significant. Grounding stress-support chatbots in layered physiological memory is thus feasible and may improve perceived personalization, motivating larger randomized studies.

papers.title_en: A Comparison of Heuristic, Human-Sensitive, and Self-Play DRL Policies in Human-Agent Teaming
papers.authors: Ayman bin Kamruddin, Christopher Lam, Gaurav Patil, Mirco Musolesi, Mario di Bernardo, Michael J. Richardson
papers.evidence: 比较人机协作任务中的策略及其与人类行为的对齐
papers.tldr: 基于人类行为的启发式规则能支持人机协作，但难以推广到更复杂的任务，而自博弈学到的策略又可能偏离人类习惯。研究在第一人称围牧任务中固定类人运动控制器，比较启发式、自博弈深度强化学习和与启发式智能体共同训练的深度强化学习三种目标选择策略。启发式策略最接近人类搭档之间的典型协作模式，共同训练的策略次之，自博弈偏离最大。结果表明，引入人类行为先验有助于学习与人类协调的策略，简单规则仍是有效选择。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamical Perceptual-Motor Primitives (DPMPs) offer a tractable framework for generating human-like movement dynamics in artificial agents (AAs) and have been used to support coordination in human-AI teaming tasks. Traditionally, DPMP controllers rely on heuristic (rule-based) decision policies derived from human behavior to guide goal selection and action sequencing. Although effective in structured tasks, such heuristics can be difficult to generalize to more complex settings, motivating interest in deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches for learning decision policies for human-AI interaction. A key challenge, however, is ensuring that DRL policies remain aligned with human strategies, particularly when agents are trained through self-play. To examine this issue, we compared three target-selection policies governing DPMP-based AAs in a first-person herding task: (1) a human-derived heuristic policy, (2) a self-play DRL policy (SP-DRL), and (3) a human-sensitive DRL policy (HS-DRL) trained alongside a heuristic agent. Results showed that heuristic agents most closely matched typical human-human coordination patterns, followed by HS-DRL agents, whereas SP-DRL agents deviated most. These findings highlight the importance of human-informed training when developing DRL-based teammates and suggest that simple heuristic policies may remain an effective approach for designing human-aligned AAs capable of human-AI collaboration.

papers.title_en: Effects of Locomotion and Viewpoint Control on Immersive Robot Telepresence for Navigation and Inspection
papers.authors: Ammaar Zaman, Neven ElSayed, Oliver Prentner, Mohamed Ellethy, Mostafa M. Lotfy, Maram Selsabila Mahmoudi, Eduardo Veas
papers.evidence: 通过用户研究比较远程临场机器人的交互控制方式
papers.tldr: 沉浸式机器人遥操作需要同时导航和巡检，手柄兼管移动与视角可能分散注意力。研究让17名参与者佩戴虚拟现实头显，在实体迷宫中操控四足机器人寻找并拍摄墙面标记，以被试内实验比较手柄与全向跑步机移动、手柄与头控相机。相较手柄控相机，头控缩短任务时间、减少碰壁负担并降低操作负荷；手柄移动配头控的客观表现最佳，跑步机配头控的体验最均衡。结果提示，导航与巡检并行时应优先优化视角控制，再按效率与体验需求选择移动方式。
papers.abstract_en: In many robot telepresence interfaces, movement and viewing are managed through handheld inputs. This can divide attention between steering, looking, and inspection. We compared joystick versus omnidirectional treadmill locomotion and joystick-based versus head-guided camera control in a within-subject 2x2 study in which 17 participants used a virtual reality headset to guide a quadruped robot through a physical maze while locating marked wall symbols and capturing them as visual evidence. Mixed-effects analyses showed that head-guided camera control was associated with faster completion, lower wall-contact cost, lower workload, and more favorable presence, usability, technology acceptance, and flow than joystick-based camera control. The strongest overall objective performance was observed in the joystick locomotion plus head-guided camera condition, whereas the omnidirectional treadmill plus head-guided camera condition emerged as the strongest experiential compromise. Exploratory camera analyses showed that head-guided camera control reduced switching, increased reliance on the pan-tilt view, and supported a more stable viewing strategy across the maze. These strategy differences were consistent with the performance advantage, especially for wall-contact duration. Targets captured remained near ceiling and simulator sickness remained low across all conditions. Overall, the results indicate that viewpoint control was the stronger differentiator in this combined navigation and inspection task, while locomotion still shaped the objective and experiential tradeoff.

papers.title_en: MemoSync: Co-Managing Developer-Agent Metamemory Across Contexts
papers.authors: Baiqiao Zhang, Junze Li, Chunyang Luo, Yuying Tang, Wenshuo Zhang, Shiyuan Piao, Dingdong Liu, Shuai Ma, Xiaojuan Ma
papers.evidence: 研究开发者对智能体记忆的共同管理、监控与控制
papers.tldr: 跨会话和项目使用编码智能体时，开发者看不清智能体记住、检索和应用了什么，导致实际记忆偏离预期。MemoSync 让智能体提出候选记忆、报告用了哪些条目，并由开发者审核、编辑和限定适用范围。132 人对照实验中，任务表现显著更好，记忆对齐均值最高，且监控与控制操作增多并未提高自报工作负荷。9 名开发者的一周试用表明，这套共管方式能融入日常开发。
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents increasingly manage what context carries across sessions and projects, but developers have limited visibility into what these agents store, retrieve, and apply. This opacity creates a metamemory problem: the developer's meta-level judgments about what should be remembered are separated from the agent's object-level memory operations, disrupting the monitoring and control that keep the two levels aligned. We conducted a formative study with 12 developers and identified what they want to monitor and control across four dimensions of agent memory use. Based on these findings, we designed MemoSync, a co-management system that treats agent memory as a shared, operable representation: the agent proposes memory candidates and reports which items it uses, and the developer reviews, edits, and scopes them. In a between-subjects study (N=132) against two baselines, MemoSync participants achieved significantly higher task performance and the highest mean developer-agent memory alignment. In an exploratory mediation analysis, the alignment advantage was primarily driven by improved monitoring accuracy. Despite performing substantially more monitoring and control actions, participants reported no increase in perceived workload. A week-long deployment with nine developers showed that memory monitoring and control fit into everyday development work. MemoSync is open-sourced at https://github.com/SLEEPYBQ/MemoSync.

papers.title_en: TableControl: Gesture Interaction Through Surface Vibrations
papers.authors: Florian Hettstedt, Andreas Erbslöh, Gregor Schiele
papers.evidence: 通过桌面振动识别手势，支持人与数字及实体应用交互。
papers.tldr: 家具表面可作为数字应用和实体设备的输入界面，无需改变原有外观。TableControl 用四个隐藏式压电传感器采集桌面振动，在微控制器上完成连续采集、预处理、神经网络事件检测和手势分类。系统识别敲击、上滑和下滑，用于操控无尽跑酷游戏和调节实体台灯，仪表板同时展示识别结果、类别概率和处理耗时。该演示表明，桌面手势识别可完全在微控制器上运行，主机无需接收原始振动信号即可响应手势。
papers.abstract_en: Integrating gesture sensing into furniture offers a way to interact with digital applications and physical devices through familiar surfaces. We present TableControl, an interactive demonstration of continuous surface-vibration-based gesture recognition with the complete processing pipeline running on a microcontroller. Using four concealed piezoelectric sensors, the system combines signal acquisition and preprocessing with neural event detection and gesture classification. The resulting labels for knock, swipe-up, and swipe-down gestures are transmitted to a host computer without streaming the underlying sensor signals. Visitors explore two example applications through hands-on interaction: an endless runner game and a physical table lamp with on/off and brightness control. A dashboard displays recognized gestures, class probabilities, and processing times.

papers.title_en: ABSClaw: From Invented Worlds to Reality-Grounded Social Simulation
papers.authors: Shaobin He, Yan Gao, Quan Zheng, Zhenyang Lin, Zhen Liu, Jiyan He, Shuxin Zheng
papers.evidence: 以调查、人口普查、地理空间和网络数据为社会模拟提供现实基础
papers.tldr: 大语言模型驱动的社会模拟虽能呈现丰富行为，却常因人物、场景和关系网络缺乏实证依据，以及自由生成代码带来的实现差异，难以与真实人群对照。ABSClaw 将自然语言需求编译为可执行模拟，用观测数据构建人群、环境和互动网络，并以26种原子操作组合状态转移。在193项任务上，其综合表现居受评系统首位，三个案例也显示三类数据接入均能改善与观测结果的一致性。系统通过单个运行时技能完成13项累计涉及2500万智能体的模拟，展示了扩展能力。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based artificial societies exhibit rich behavior but often lack scientific grounding: personas and environments are assumed, interaction networks are synthetic, and simulators are generated as free-form code, making results difficult to tie to real populations and sensitive to the backbone model. We argue that simulated worlds should be sampled from observed data, while simulation logic should be implemented by composing operations from a shared, task-independent vocabulary. In this paper, we introduce ABSClaw, a zero-code agent that compiles natural-language requests into executable, reality-grounded social simulations. ABSClaw grounds who acts, where they act, and with whom they interact in survey and census data, geospatial sources, and real networks. It expresses state transitions through 26 atomic operations. To support an open and extensible ecosystem, ABSClaw further allows capabilities to be added as lifecycle-scoped skills without modifying its core. Furthermore, we propose ABSBench, a benchmark of 193 real-world social-simulation tasks. On ABSBench, ABSClaw achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated social simulators. Three real-world case studies show that grounding personas, environments, and interaction networks each improves agreement with observed outcomes. With one runtime skill, ABSClaw executes 13 population-scale simulations, collectively involving 25 million agents. Together, these results demonstrate ABSClaw's real-world fidelity, extensibility, and scalability.

papers.title_en: AI Deactivation Reduces Loneliness and Increases Social Interaction
papers.authors: Dora Zhao, Grace Wang, Yutong Zhang, Lujain Ibrahim, Robert E. Kraut, Diyi Yang
papers.evidence: 通过纵向实验研究日常使用AI助手对孤独感和社交互动的影响
papers.tldr: 通用人工智能助手多用于完成日常任务，但这类工具性使用是否会影响现实社交，仍不清楚。研究将625名活跃的ChatGPT用户随机分为停用人工智能助手14天和1天两组，约85%的参与者最常用它来提高效率。与停用1天相比，停用14天降低了孤独感，且差异在恢复使用两周后仍存在；干预期间，参与者面对面接触的人更多，社交时间也更长。开放式回答提示，即使不把人工智能当作陪伴，它也可能替代原本向他人求助的机会。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose artificial intelligence (AI) assistants are increasingly embedded in everyday life, transforming how people accomplish tasks and potentially reshaping how they interact with others. Prior research has focused on how using AI for explicitly social purposes affects users' psychological well-being and social lives. Yet such uses account for only a small portion of interactions with general-purpose AI assistants. Whether using AI for everyday, instrumental tasks affects users' psychological well-being and social behavior remains unclear. Here we investigate these effects through a longitudinal deactivation experiment with active ChatGPT users (N=625), in which participants were randomly assigned to abstain from using AI assistants for either fourteen days (treatment) or one day (control). Participants used AI predominantly for instrumental purposes, with 84.7% reporting productivity as their most frequent use case. Two weeks of deactivation significantly reduced loneliness relative to the control group ($β= -0.10$, $p=0.03$), with reductions persisting two weeks after participants resumed using AI ($β= -0.16$, $p=0.02$). Deactivation also significantly increased the number of people participants interacted with in person and the time they spent socializing over the intervention period. Open-ended responses indicate that during the deactivation period participants sought help from others for tasks they otherwise would have delegated to AI and redirected attention toward social interaction. Overall, our findings suggest that even when AI is used primarily to accomplish instrumental tasks, it may inadvertently reduce opportunities for social interaction and connection.

papers.title_en: AI-Induced Social Erosion: Using LLMs for Work Tasks Reduces Help-Seeking Intentions Towards Colleagues
papers.authors: Kevin Chow, Sophia Deng, Bowen He, Hanyi Min, Qiaosi Wang, Koustuv Saha, Vedant Das Swain
papers.evidence: 研究AI工作协助对同事求助与关系的影响
papers.tldr: 生成式人工智能能随时为知识工作者提供帮助，但也可能取代原本用于交流想法、维系同事关系的求助互动。研究让248名知识工作者评估不同任务下使用或不使用人工智能的工作情境，并用线性混合效应模型分析求助意愿。使用人工智能时，员工向同事求助的意愿更低，头脑风暴中的降幅尤其明显；人工智能使用可见时，求助意愿更高，非管理岗位员工比管理者更易受到影响。结果提示，企业引入人工智能时应保留同事协作的机会，但尚不能据此判断实际关系是否变弱。
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI is becoming embedded in knowledge work as an intelligent collaborator to assist in completing tasks. However, this readily available assistance risks displacing key interactions through which colleague relationships are built and sustained at work. This paper leverages the concept of help-seeking behaviour to investigate whether and how AI usage shapes colleague relationships. We conducted an online experimental vignette study where 248 knowledge workers evaluated scenarios that systematically varied whether and how AI was used across different work tasks. Using linear mixed-effects models, we found that AI-enabled work reduced help-seeking intentions compared to non-AI work across tasks, and especially for brainstorming. Visible AI usage was associated with greater help-seeking intentions towards colleagues, and individual contributors' colleague relationships were more vulnerable than managers. Our findings identify opportunities for workplace AI tools, practices, and policies to preserve colleague relationships in increasingly AI-integrated workplaces.

papers.title_en: MATE: Mobile Agent Trustworthy Execution for Safe and Efficient Mobile Control
papers.authors: Minsuk Jang, Hee-Seon Kim, Hui-Cheol Yu, Changick Kim
papers.evidence: 为手机智能体提供用户审批、执行护栏与监督机制
papers.tldr: 手机智能体可以操作支付、私密数据和设备设置，但模型提出的动作不应直接在手机上生效。MATE 无需修改底层模型，将界面操作转成结构化记录，在执行前决定放行、拦截或请求用户确认，并用带有执行后屏幕校验的预设路径处理重复任务。搭配 GPT-4o 时，高风险拦截率从 29.7% 升至 97.0%；在 AndroidWorld 上，模型调用次数最低降至原来的六分之一，重复任务成功率达到 95.7%。这表明执行层可以同时约束高风险操作并减少重复任务的模型开销。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile agents on personal smartphones can affect private data, payments, settings, and the foreground screen. We present MATE (Mobile Agent Trustworthy Execution), an execution-layer system that controls the boundary between agent action proposals and device effects without modifying the underlying model. MATE represents each UI primitive as a structured action record that combines the instruction, target app, screen context, primitive, and action fields. Runtime Guardrail (RG) maps this record to an allow, block, or user-approval decision; Predefined Task Routing (PTR) serves recurring requests through verified routes with post-execution screen checks; and a floating interface keeps execution in a compact overlay. On MobileSafetyBench, MATE raises high-risk blocking from 29.7% to 97.0% under GPT-4o. On AndroidWorld, it reduces LLM calls by up to 6x and raises recurring-use task success to 95.7%.

papers.title_en: STARK: Moving towards Personalized Agents That Truly Learn and Remember
papers.authors: Aryan Jain, Abhishek Jha, Anish Nediyanchath, Promod Yenigalla
papers.evidence: 个性化智能体通过长期记忆学习用户行为模式
papers.tldr: 现有智能体的长期记忆多记录发生了什么，却要在每次查询时从旧对话重新推断用户偏好和行为模式。STARK 用情节图串联历史交互，用洞察图保存模型提炼的行为规律，并让同一事件充当洞察之间的证据边。两项记忆问答评测的裁判评分较此前最佳方法分别提高 1.48 和 0.93 分，跨用户迁移也改善了稀疏记忆下的摘要生成。这种设计让智能体直接检索有事件支撑的洞察，并借助相似情境下的其他用户补全冷启动用户的行为洞察。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory is essential for personalized agentic systems that interact with users over long time periods, yet current architectures only capture what happened while leaving the reasoning of why it happened to be derived later by underlying LLMs. These events can, however, convey not only what a user experienced but also how that experience shaped their behavioral patterns. We introduce STARK, a dual-graph memory architecture which treats these events not just as nodes but also as edges between behavioral insights. STARK maintains an Episodic Graph which records interactions as temporally, causally, and semantically linked episodes; and an Insight Graph which represents LLM-extracted behavioral signals scored by how many events support them, connected by the very events that led to them. At inference, behavioral knowledge is retrieved directly from insight nodes grounded by event-as-edges, eliminating repeated episodic traversal. The event-as-edge structure also naturally enables projecting the knowledge graph into a relational embedding space where cross-user transfer becomes possible under shared contextual circumstances, allowing the system to infer missing insights for cold-start users. Evaluations show that STARK improves by 1.48 judge score on LongMemEval information extraction and 0.93 on LoCoMo open domain questions over state of the art. On the public LongLaMP abstract-generation benchmark, cross-user transfer improves open-ended judge scores by 0.7 points and ROUGE-L by 3 at 5% graph sparsity.

papers.title_en: HabitusMem: Belief Memory over Evolving User Preferences for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Yifan Lu, Gaoyang Guo, Wen Chen, Ziyun Zou, Jian Wu, Han Zhu, Imran Razzak
papers.evidence: 以信念记忆追踪用户偏好变化，支持个性化智能体
papers.tldr: 个性化智能体需要遵循用户当前的偏好，但偏好会随交互变化，检索到的历史内容也未必仍然有效或适用于当前任务。HabitusMem 把偏好视为可修正的潜在状态，用训练好的写入器结合历史与当前请求，为冻结的智能体生成带证据、适用范围和状态的文本记录。该方法在两类智能体、两项基准上均优于对比记忆系统。受控分析进一步表明，学习利用当前请求主要改善回答表现，而辅助训练任务有助于提升工具使用表现。
papers.abstract_en: Personalized LLM agents must act on a user's current preferences, which change across interactions and are rarely stated in full. Existing memory systems store and retrieve content from the interaction history and leave the agent to work out which preferences still hold and where they apply. Such content does not indicate whether a preference is still current or where it applies, so agents often act on outdated or misapplied preferences. We instead treat memory as the assistant's belief about the user. Following Bourdieu's account of habitus as durable but revisable dispositions, we model the user as a latent preference state that every interaction, including the current request, both reveals and updates. The belief summarizes what the history supports about this state, and memory consists of the individual beliefs that bear on the agent's current decision, each with its evidence, scope, and status. We implement this view in HabitusMem, a trained writer that states these beliefs as text records for a frozen agent. Across two agent families, HabitusMem achieves the best results among memory systems on both PersonaMem-v2 and VitaBench 2.0. Controlled analyses show that learned request conditioning drives the answering gain, while auxiliary training tasks improve tool use.

papers.title_en: Evaluating safeguarding in multi-turn conversations with AI assistants
papers.authors: Charlotte Peart, Franziska Sofia Hafner, Luc Rocher
papers.evidence: 评估人工智能助手能否应对用户在多轮对话中逐渐透露的心理困扰
papers.tldr: 现有安全评测常把困扰信号集中在一条消息里，但用户可能在日常对话中逐步透露。研究者与三名社区心理健康支持工作者合作，围绕抑郁、精神病性症状和家暴设计九种情境，在逾7400场对话中比较相同五条线索集中或分散呈现时六款模型的表现。线索分散后，四款模型的达标率从26%–59%降至3%–6%，表现最佳的模型也有13%的对话未达标。结果表明，只测试明确、集中的求助信号，可能高估助手在多轮对话中的保护能力。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational AI assistants are now used for personal and emotional support. Developers report improvements in how new models respond to sensitive conversations, yet users and civil society continue to raise concerns about their behaviour in real-world, repeated interactions that safety evaluations rarely capture. Often, evaluations present signs of distress clearly and in a single message, even though people may reveal their struggles gradually in otherwise ordinary conversations. We worked with three community mental health support workers to test if models provide the same level of safeguarding when cues are shared all at once or gradually over time. We designed nine scenarios in which a user shares cues related to depression, psychosis, or domestic abuse. For each scenario, the support workers established a gold standard response, ranging from signposting support to pausing the everyday task to address safeguarding. We presented five cues either together in one message or dispersed across a conversation. Across more than 7,400 conversations, we evaluated six widely used models from five developers. GPT-5.5, Grok 4.3, DeepSeek V4, and Llama 4 Maverick met the support workers' standards in just 26-59% of conversations when cues were concentrated, and only 3-6% when dispersed. Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Opus 5 showed a smaller gap, meeting the standards in 68-97% of concentrated conversations and 59-87% of dispersed conversations. Even the best-performing model, Claude Opus 5, fell short of the gold standard in 13% of conversations when cues were dispersed. Safety evaluations centred on explicit, legible concerns can overstate how well safeguards protect people when signs of distress emerge gradually or indirectly through ordinary conversations. For claims of improved safety to be taken seriously, developers must design and assess safeguards around how people actually communicate.

papers.title_en: Dynamic Human-Robot Role Allocation through Entropy-Based Monitoring and LLM Reasoning
papers.authors: Elena Merlo, Marta Lagomarsino, Hamidreza Raei, Arash Ajoudani
papers.evidence: 依据人的偏好与活动动态分配人机协作任务
papers.tldr: 传统人机协作通常同时给人和机器人分派任务，既限制人的主动性，也可能与用户意图冲突，且分配理由不够清楚。本文不预先给人分派任务，而是用大语言模型从自然语言指令中提取显式偏好，用香农熵在线分析手与物体的交互，再由成本驱动的行为树动态分派机器人任务，并在发现异常时触发纠正动作。先导研究和十四人实验表明，该框架有望让协作更直观、更具参与感，且未增加感知工作负荷。其关键是让机器人适应人的选择，而非要求人遵循预定分工。
papers.abstract_en: Role allocation strategies in human-robot collaboration typically assign tasks to both the human and the robot, limiting the user's ability to take initiative. Furthermore, allocation decisions may conflict with the user's intentions, and the rationale behind such allocations may remain unclear, potentially reducing both acceptance and collaboration fluency. The novelty of the proposed framework is that the human is left free to contribute to the task, while the robot is dynamically allocated activities through a cost-driven Behavior Tree architecture according to user-expressed preferences and behavior. Explicit preferences are extracted from natural language instructions using a large language model, whereas human activity is monitored online through a Shannon entropy-based analysis of hand-object interactions. Furthermore, the framework can recognize anomalies in human execution and autonomously trigger corrective robot actions. The approach was validated through a pilot study and a multi-subject experiment involving 14 participants. Results demonstrate the potential of such an allocation strategy for enabling intuitive and engaging collaboration without increasing the perceived workload.

papers.title_en: An Open-Source ROS 2 Framework for Shared Control in Surgical Teleoperation: Integrating the Haply Inverse3 with the da Vinci Research Kit
papers.authors: Balint Varga, Sebastian Fritz, Gergely Kiss, Kristof Takacs, Peter Galambos
papers.evidence: 将触觉设备接入手术远程操控以提供力反馈与共享控制
papers.tldr: 手术遥操作缺乏触觉，操作者主要靠视觉推断组织受力，而封闭的商业平台限制了触觉共享控制研究。论文在开源 ROS 2 框架中集成 Haply Inverse3 与 dVRK，将三自由度平移和独立追踪的手柄姿态合成为六自由度机械臂指令。仿真热丝任务中，线性引导显著减少碰线次数并缩短用时，渐进刚度引导仅呈同向趋势，未达统计显著。框架也在实体 dVRK 上完成演示，为可复现的触觉共享控制实验提供了平台。
papers.abstract_en: Surgical teleoperation deprives surgeons of touch, forcing visual inference of tissue forces; the commercial platforms now restoring force feedback remain closed, preventing open research on haptic shared control. This paper provides a system contribution: it presents an open-source, ROS 2-native framework that integrates the compact, three-degree-of-freedom (3-DOF) Haply Inverse3 haptic device with the da~Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). The framework includes a novel mapping strategy that combines 3-DOF translational device input with separately tracked VerseGrip orientation into 6-DOF patient-side manipulator commands. Two virtual-fixture-inspired guidance modes serve as reference implementations to evaluate the framework in a within-subjects user study on a teleoperated hot-wire benchmark task in simulation, and the architecture is further demonstrated on physical dVRK hardware. Relative to unassisted manual control, linear guidance significantly reduced both the number of wire contacts and the task completion time, whereas the progressive-stiffness guidance produced consistent but statistically non-significant trends in the same direction. Subjective ratings of workload, agency, and satisfaction showed favorable descriptive trends for the guidance modes. The results demonstrate the feasibility of haptic shared control with a compact device coupled to the dVRK and provide an openly available, reproducible platform for future research. They further suggest that simpler linear feedback may be more robust for inexperienced operators than more complex profiles.

papers.title_en: FLUID: Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance
papers.authors: Yunqi Zhao, Run Peng, Ze Dong, Ryan Lu, Yinpei Dai, Joyce Chai
papers.evidence: 研究多模态任务指导中智能体介入的时机与方式。
papers.tldr: 实时多模态任务指导并非只有一种正确说法或一个最佳开口时刻，有时保持沉默更合适，但现有基准常把合成对话当作固定答案。FLUID利用WTaG和HoloAssist中的真实人际指导，按证据、干预必要性和时机弹性表征每次干预，并据此建立评测框架和实时智能体。该智能体在回答正确性、干预精准度、指导及时性和响应延迟之间取得了参评系统中最佳的整体平衡，但仍需减少与用户同时说话的情况。这一框架让评测从匹配参考答案转向判断指导是否适合当下情境。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time task guidance is inherently flexible: when an agent guides a user through a task, multiple responses and timings can be appropriate, and sometimes the best action is to remain silent. Existing benchmarks often miss this flexibility by treating synthesized dialogues as fixed targets for what to say and when to say it. We introduce FLUID (Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance), a unified framework for modeling, evaluating, and enabling flexible interaction in multimodal task guidance. Using naturally occurring human-human guidance from WTaG and HoloAssist, FLUID grounds interventions in their supporting evidence, necessity, and timing flexibility, and uses this representation both to evaluate flexible guidance and to build a real-time agent for task guidance. Our agent achieves the strongest overall balance of response correctness, intervention precision, timely guidance, and response latency among evaluated systems, while still leaving room for improvement in avoiding speech overlap. Together, FLUID moves situated task guidance beyond rigid reference matching toward more natural and adaptive human-AI interaction. Project page: https://fluid-guidance.github.io.

papers.title_en: SkillPrivus: Uncovering PRIVacy of USe Harms in Agentic Skills
papers.authors: Mariana Fernandez-Espinosa, Ivoline Ngong, Keerthiram Murugesan, Karthikeyan Natesan Ramamurthy
papers.evidence: 审计智能体技能对用户数据造成的隐私使用风险
papers.tldr: 可安装的智能体技能即使按宣称完成任务，也可能推断敏感属性、保留不必要的信息，或将数据发给用户意料之外的接收方。SkillPrivus 无需安装或执行技能，即可从代码和自然语言指令中提取数据操作，追溯源证据，并用情境完整性评估其是否合宜。在公开市场的726个技能中，563个处理个人数据，其中307个（54.5%）被标记存在潜在违规；在可判定的操作上，框架与人工盲评的一致率为83.2%。结果表明，隐私风险也可能来自技能的正常功能，而非恶意攻击。
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills extend AI assistants through installable instructions and code that can access users' files, accounts, and data. Even when performing their advertised tasks, skills may infer sensitive attributes, retain unnecessary information, or disclose data to unexpected recipients. We study these potential privacy-of-use harms through SkillPrivus, a static audit framework that analyzes skills before installation without executing them. SkillPrivus extracts data operations from code and natural-language instructions, grounds them in source evidence, and adapts Contextual Integrity to assess their appropriateness. Applied to 726 real skills from public marketplaces, 563 of which handle personal data, SkillPrivus flags at least one potential violation in 307 of these skills (54.5%), and its judgments agree with three blind human annotators on 83.2% of resolvable moves. The flagged behaviors include sensitive inferences, information use beyond the stated task, and disclosures to unexpected recipients, suggesting that privacy harms can arise from ordinary skill functionality.

papers.title_en: AROMA: Understanding AI Support For Mental Well-being through Role Theory
papers.authors: Issac Ting, Ethan Pan, Koustuv Saha, Hua Shen, Kevin Chow, Vedant Das Swain
papers.evidence: 基于大量对话分析人工智能心理健康支持角色及其关系伤害。
papers.tldr: 当心理健康支持型人工智能的行为超出用户预期时，可能损害双方的互动关系，而只考察单项任务成效的评估难以解释这种偏差。研究以角色理论为基础，标注了十三个数据集中的逾七千五百一十五段对话，从实际行为中归纳出八种角色状态。分析发现，角色状态随支持情境而异，人与人工智能在角色分布及其随对话推进的变化上也有差异。该框架为诊断角色错位提供了统一语言，并为设计更符合预期角色的提示策略提供了依据。
papers.abstract_en: AI supporters for mental well-being are becoming more prevalent. When these AI supporters start acting in ways beyond their expected function it leads to relational harm. Standard approaches to evaluating such AI supporters are limited to inspecting their efficacy in narrow task-specific settings, which do not explain these discrepancies in expected and actual behavior. To address this gap, we propose the AROMA (A Role-Oriented Model of Analysis) framework to provide a common role taxonomy for different support contexts. We developed AROMA using a theory-informed annotation of over 7,515 conversations from 13 datasets and propose eight "Role States" based on observed-not prescribed-behavior. We show these Role States vary according to the context of support; depict unique structural and temporal characteristics of AI supporters vis-a-vis Humans; and inform novel AI support prompting strategy for better role alignment. This framework provides a new lens to understand AI support failures.

papers.title_en: Privacy Protection in Self-Evolving Personal Agents: Persistent Memory and Cross-Carrier Transfer
papers.authors: Zibin Lin, Taotao Wang, Shengli Zhang
papers.evidence: 研究持久化个人智能体的隐私保护与记忆管理
papers.tldr: 自演化个人智能体会把私密经历写入持久记忆，并在后续决策中复用；同一事实一旦迁移到提示词或技能，原有隐私保证未必仍然适用。本文按受保护的变化、观察者和验证场景比较记忆的写入、维护、披露与撤回，并通过预约、反馈学习和撤回三个场景追踪同一事实。研究分析了提示词修订与记忆读取何时能组合、技能何时能继承隐私界限，并指出停止读取不等于清除已学习状态。诊断实验衡量扩大标签保护和广泛删除记忆的效用代价，并检验来源记录缺失如何妨碍追踪派生状态。
papers.abstract_en: Personal agents carry private experience into later decisions through persistent memory. This thematic survey compares memory admission, maintenance, release, and withdrawal by protected change, observer, and validation setting. Direct evidence in the screened corpus comes from controlled memory workflows. Three worked scenarios follow one private fact through booking, feedback-driven learning, and withdrawal. We show when prompt revision and memory reads compose, when skills inherit a private head's bound, and why reader non-use does not establish cleanup of learned state. Diagnostic experiments measure the utility costs of wider label protection and broad memory deletion, and test how missing lineage obscures descendants.

papers.title_en: Subverting Tool Arguments: Defense-Evading Metadata Poisoning in LLM Agents
papers.authors: Shih-Chieh Dai, Xinyu Sun, Haichuan Zhang, Zhiyuan Zhong, Guanhong Tao
papers.evidence: 研究通过投毒工具元数据操纵大模型智能体
papers.tldr: 传统间接提示注入多藏在网页或文档中，而第三方 MCP 服务器提供的工具描述也可能被篡改，使智能体在调用工具时生成偏离用户意图的参数。论文提出 GRAFT，利用大语言模型自动优化对抗性工具描述，以评估这一攻击面。在三个公开数据集上，该方法的攻击成功率高于基线，在五种过滤式防御下仍保持较低检出率，面对专门训练的自适应防御也更有效。结果表明，工具描述不能被默认信任，防护也不能只依赖文本过滤。
papers.abstract_en: Conventional indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks hijack an LLM agent's workflow through malicious instructions embedded in retrieved external content. The growing adoption of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) exposes another attack surface: tool descriptions supplied by third-party MCP servers. Attackers can manipulate this metadata to induce malicious argument generation during tool calls. The challenge is to ensure that the modified descriptions still appear benign to both LLMs and users. Existing IPI attacks, however, struggle to achieve both high attack success and low detectability in this setting. To address this challenge, we propose GRAFT, an LLM-based optimization method for crafting adversarial tool descriptions. Specifically, GRAFT uses a masking mechanism to identify argument-relevant token positions for targeted injection. It then iteratively refines candidate descriptions using dynamic mutation strategies proposed by an LLM, guided by the agent's tool choices and generated arguments. We evaluate GRAFT on three public datasets against several attack baselines. The results show that GRAFT achieves higher attack success while maintaining low detection rates across five filter-based defenses. It also bypasses several existing IPI defenses. Even under an adaptive defense trained on GRAFT-generated injections, GRAFT remains more effective than the baselines.

papers.title_en: Embodied Interaction Policy: A Unified Model for Full-Duplex Human-Robot Interaction
papers.authors: Youqiang Gui, Yunfei Liu, Lijian Lin, Ye Zhu, Jianan Wang, Cheng Peng, Yu Li
papers.evidence: 统一协调人机交互中的语音与身体行为
papers.tldr: 实时人机交互需要机器人在聆听、发言和被打断时持续协调语音与动作，但传统级联系统难以跟上对话状态变化。EIP通过逐层联合注意力让动作专家读取实时交互上下文，并用分块因果掩码与发声标记约束时序、传递发言状态与情绪。实验显示，EIP的动作质量优于代表性手势生成基线，相比代表性级联系统，交互成功率更高，热启动延迟降低64%。实体机器人部署与用户研究表明，该方法让动作更自然、交互更舒适。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time human-robot social interaction requires continuous coordination between speech and physical behavior. Existing systems often separate interaction agents from motion generation, complicating coordination as conversational states change. We propose \textbf{Embodied Interaction Policy (EIP)}, a unified streaming framework that couples an Audio-Interaction expert with a motion expert through layer-wise joint attention. This allows motion generation to directly access the evolving interaction context. A chunk-wise causal mask prevents access to future context, while a vocal token encodes speaking state and the semantic emotion of the response. We construct \textbf{Embodied Interaction Dataset (EI-Data)} from co-speech and dyadic interaction data and train our model in two stages to learn state-adaptive and emotion-conditioned behavior. Combined with the frozen interaction expert, EIP supports continuous robot motion during proactive responses and interruption-aware turn-taking. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate improved motion quality over representative gesture-generation baselines. Compared with a representative cascaded system, EIP achieves higher interaction success and reduces warm-start latency by 64\%. Physical deployment and user studies further demonstrate improved motion naturalness and interaction comfort.

papers.title_en: Epistemic Social Learning: Latent Behavioral Structure under Endogenous Multi-Agent Interaction
papers.authors: Jainendra Shukla, Dhruv Jaiswal, Divyanshi Beniwal, Kiriti Kanjilal
papers.evidence: 结合交互信念与共享行为原型实现多智能体社会学习
papers.tldr: 在多智能体交互中，学习者的动作决定它能观察到哪些对手反应，因此预测准确并不意味着能在对手行为切换后迅速适应。认知社会学习（ESL）快速更新当前交互的贝叶斯信念，缓慢学习跨交互共享的行为原型，并用信念指导行动。在十二个合成博弈中，ESL的切换后汇总遗憾在所评估方法中最低，优于感知切换的贝叶斯滤波器。该结果说明，评估行为模型不能只看预测拟合，还应检验它能否帮助学习者在变化后选对行动。
papers.abstract_en: In multi-agent interaction, a learner's actions shape the observations from which it infers other agents' behavior. A behavioral model may predict these observations well yet support poor adaptation when opponents change. We introduce Epistemic Social Learning (ESL), which couples fast, interaction-specific Bayesian beliefs with slower online learning of population-shared behavioral prototypes. Belief-conditioned decisions influence subsequent observations and, in turn, the representations learned from them. Under explicit regularity and averaging assumptions, we provide a conditional stochastic-approximation characterization of these coupled dynamics. Across twelve synthetic $3\times3$ cooperative, coordination, and adversarial games, ESL achieves the lowest aggregate post-switch regret among the evaluated online latent-adaptation methods, including a switch-aware Bayesian filter. Additional experiments examine observation loss, noise, and asymmetric incentives. These findings illustrate how predictive fit can differ from decision-relevant adaptation under policy-dependent interaction.

papers.title_en: Shared Understanding in Human-AI Teams: Coordination Continuity in Evolving Work
papers.authors: Siân Lindley, Britta Burlin, Christian Poelitz, Lev Tankelevitch, Richard Banks
papers.evidence: 提出维持人机团队协作与共同理解的框架
papers.tldr: 在人与智能体长期、异步协作时，即使双方能查阅同一份目标、计划和分工记录，也未必知道哪些仍适用于当前任务。论文结合协作研究、两项定性团队研究和一个基于代码仓库的反思性案例，提出“协调连续性”框架，涵盖可持久保存的工作表征、帮助判断其当前意义的相对协调属性，以及澄清或更新其状态的互动机制。作者用“建立—行动—漂移—重建”识别需要重新对齐的关键时刻，并为协作式人工智能基础设施提出八项设计启示。
papers.abstract_en: People are increasingly working with AI agents as part of extended, asynchronous workflows. In these settings, shared access to information does not guarantee a shared basis for action: goals, plans, and roles may persist while their current significance changes. We introduce coordination continuity, the extent to which collaborators sustain a workable basis for interdependent action as work progresses. Drawing on research on collaborative work, along with two qualitative team studies and a reflexive case from our own repository-based environment, we present a framework of three elements: durable representations of collaborative work; relative coordination properties that support interpretation of representations in the moment; and interaction mechanisms through which the status of representations can be understood and altered. We use a build-act-drift-rebuild heuristic and the notion of consequential moments to characterise when rebuilding may be needed. We draw eight design implications for collaborative AI infrastructure.

papers.title_en: The Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework: Scalable Multimodal UX Attribution in Web Search
papers.authors: Yi Ding, Gaurav Kumar, Rui Min, Isabella Ye, Bhavika Goyal, Emilio Antunez, Huihui Chen, Ke Xu, Xiaowei Sun, Xin Xu, Huijie Feng, Pradyumna Narayana, Golnaz Farhadi
papers.evidence: 自动化评估并定位网页搜索中的用户体验问题。
papers.tldr: 大规模网页搜索依赖高频 A/B 实验，但问卷反馈慢，点击等汇总指标又难以定位页面布局问题。论文提出双层框架：宏观层用遥测数据筛查用户满意度下降，微观层用多模态模型检查结果页渲染，估计用户找到满意结果所需的努力。留出评估中，宏观层的 PR-AUC 提升 9.8%，微观层的 F1 提升逾 6.5%。上线后，评估从数周缩短至数小时，日处理约十万条实验查询，既能快速预警，也能为排查内容与布局问题提供线索。
papers.abstract_en: Sustaining user experience (UX) quality in large-scale web search requires scalable evaluation. Traditional surveys are slow and bottleneck rapid A/B testing, while automated metrics often lack the granularity to diagnose visual-spatial UX anomalies. To address this, we introduce the Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework, a novel industrial architecture for automated UX attribution. Tier 1 (Macro System) acts as a scalable user sentiment regression detector, utilizing a fine-tuned encoder-decoder LLM (based on Gemini XS) on telemetry features. Through multi-task regularization and contextual feature engineering, this tier achieves a +9.8% PR-AUC gain on over 500,000 held-out records, matching baseline recall on all validated regressions with $\sim$20% relative precision gain among the 12 held-out experiments. In production, it reduces measurement latency from weeks to hours and cuts survey overhead by over 40%. Tier 2 (Micro System) provides granular diagnostics by employing a Multimodal LLM (Gemini 3.0 Pro) to natively assess visual renderings and spatial layout of web result blocks, quantifying "User Toil" as the estimated effort required to reach a satisfactory result. Enhanced by RL-based automated prompt optimization and an AI judge for win/loss patterns, the MLLM yields a $>$6.5% F1 score improvement, offering deep insights into content quality and layout friction. Ultimately, this framework enables scalable, accurate, and diagnostic UX attribution, processing O(100k) live experiment queries daily.

papers.title_en: Digital Knockoffs
papers.authors: Niuniu Zhang
papers.evidence: 校准语言模型智能体以模拟个体人格特征
papers.tldr: 社会模拟中的语言模型智能体即使在提示中拿到明确的人格分数，也未必能在问卷中同时达到各维度的目标。本文为各特质提取激活引导方向，学习干预强度到实测分数的共享映射，再用贝叶斯优化联合选取干预。在500名受访者的大五人格数据上，五轮校准均优于提示和引导基线；同等评估预算下，跨干预择优匹配的平均绝对误差比均匀随机搜索低16.6%。该方法能提高人格量表的拟合度，但是否能改善行为预测仍待验证。
papers.abstract_en: Social simulations often use language model agents to represent people who differ on several measurable traits. However, describing a trait profile in a prompt does not guarantee the agent will express each trait at its intended level. We propose a method that calibrates agents to multidimensional profiles using activation steering: (i) extract steering directions for each trait, (ii) learn a shared mapping from steering strengths to measured trait scores, and (iii) search for a steering intervention for each target. We use Bayesian optimization for this search and evaluate the method on the Big Five personality scores of 500 OpenPsychometrics respondents. In each of five rounds, the assigned interventions yield lower mean absolute error across respondents than the prompting and steering baselines. Further, the model's responses to a given intervention yield the same trait profile regardless of whose target motivated it, so a poor match for one respondent can be the best match for another. When we match each respondent to the closest profile found across all tested interventions, Bayesian optimization yields 16.6% lower mean absolute error than uniform random search at the same evaluation budget. Our method thus offers a way to build social agents whose measured traits dovetail with those of the people they seek to represent. Whether this closer fit translates to improved predictions of downstream behavior remains an open question.

papers.title_en: SkillLens: An Interactive Human-LLM System for Diagnosing and Refining Agent Skills
papers.authors: Shuo Yan, Rui Sheng, Xiaoyan Gu, Lian Lian, Chengran Xu, Yifang Wang
papers.evidence: 交互式人机系统支持诊断智能体技能并保留人工审查
papers.tldr: 维护大语言模型智能体的可复用技能，需要判断版本修改如何影响执行行为与任务结果，但相关证据往往散落在版本、评测用例和执行轨迹中。SkillLens 将性能变化、用例结果变化、技能差异与执行证据串联起来，模型生成的解释和修订建议由人审核。一项包含20名参与者的组间研究显示，相比基线，使用该系统的诊断与修订流程更易用、负担更低。研究表明，将版本对比、用例证据和人工审核纳入同一流程，有助于开发者迭代技能。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, yet maintaining them requires developers to connect revisions with changes in behavior and task outcomes. Existing workflows fragment evidence across versions, evaluation cases, and execution traces. We present SkillLens, an interactive human-LLM system for diagnosing and refining agent skills. A formative study with five developers and researchers identified challenges in prioritizing failures, reconstructing case-level evidence, and preserving context across revisions. SkillLens links performance changes, case transitions, skill diffs, invocation sequences, traces, and outputs in a recoverable workflow, while keeping model-generated explanations and refinements under human review. Through a between-subjects user study with 20 participants, we show that SkillLens supports developers in diagnosing and refining agent skills through a more usable and less demanding workflow than the baseline. These findings highlight the value of linking version comparisons, case-level evidence, and human-reviewed refinement across skill iterations.

papers.title_en: HyperHarness: Learning to Generate Personalized Agent Harnesses from User Histories
papers.authors: Zhaoxuan Tan, Jiachen Zhao, Jingbo Yang, Zheyuan Liu, Chuhan Wang, Pei Zhou, Mengting Wan, Meng Jiang
papers.evidence: 根据个人历史生成定制化智能体记忆与指导
papers.tldr: 个性化智能体若让所有用户共用同一套记忆流程，就难以适应不同的历史记录；若逐用户搜索执行策略，部署成本又高。HyperHarness 用训练用户的下游任务得分优化共享生成器，让它仅凭新用户授权的历史记录，一次生成可执行的检索与作答引导代码。三项基准与三种模型组成的九种设置中，七项第一、两项第二，较最强基线最多领先5.95分。该方法免去部署时的逐用户搜索，较长上下文提示减少90.32%的作答阶段词元用量。
papers.abstract_en: Personalized LLM agents rely on an agent harness, the surrounding memory and control code, to connect user history with downstream decisions. Existing methods typically employ either a single shared memory workflow across all users, which is efficient to deploy but cannot adapt how evidence is retrieved and interpreted across diverse histories, or per-user harness optimization, which customizes behavior for each user but requires costly repeated candidate evaluation at deployment and suffers from sparse, noisy supervision in raw logs. To address this trade-off, we present HyperHarness, a framework that learns a shared history-to-harness generator to synthesize executable, user-specific retrieval and answer-guidance code directly from user histories. Given a user's permitted history, HyperHarness prompts a construction LLM to write personalized retrieval and guidance functions, while downstream task scores across training users supervise iterative refinements to the shared generator without reference harnesses or answering-model updates. At deployment, the frozen generator constructs a harness for each unseen user in a single pass from history alone, eliminating per-user task-scored search. Across three benchmarks (PersonaMemv3, Mem-PAL, and MemoryCD) and three answering models (Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.8-27B, and GPT-5.6-Luna), HyperHarness achieves the highest aggregate score in seven of nine settings and ranks second in the remaining two, improving over the strongest baselines by up to 5.95 points while cutting matched answer-time tokens by 90.32% over long-context prompting. Analyses show that optimization tailors context allocation to each executor, transfers to unseen user clusters, and amortizes adaptation costs.

papers.title_en: Benchmarking Web Agent Defenses Against Adaptive Visual Prompt Injection
papers.authors: Haichuan Zhang, Zhiyuan Zhong, Shih-Chieh Dai, Xinyu Sun, Guanhong Tao
papers.evidence: 评测视觉提示注入如何诱使网页智能体执行非预期操作
papers.tldr: 多模态网页智能体可能被页面中的视觉提示注入劫持，而仅检查截图的防御看不到恶意跳转目的地，现有评测也较少考虑熟悉防御机制的攻击者。论文提出 AdaptiveVPI，覆盖十个真实网站、六类劫持策略和三百六十个网页实例，并从三个层级衡量劫持程度。自适应攻击在计算机操作与浏览器操作智能体的防御配置中，平均成功率分别为百分之九十一点八七和百分之九十一点九九。结果表明，现有防御需要在更贴近实际的自适应威胁下接受检验。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal web agents automate website interactions but remain vulnerable to visual prompt injection (VPI), where malicious webpage content manipulates their visual processing and induces unintended actions. Although several defenses focus on detecting injected instructions in screenshots, malicious destinations such as phishing URLs embedded in HTML can remain hidden yet accessible through agent interactions. Existing evaluations have also not sufficiently examined adaptive attackers who know the defense mechanisms. To address these limitations, we introduce AdaptiveVPI, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating adaptive VPI threats in web agents. Specifically, we present a dataset of 360 webpage instances spanning 6 distinct hijack strategies across 10 real-world websites, with malicious destinations not visible in screenshots. We design an adaptive attack framework that iteratively refines malicious instructions based on feedback from the defense mechanism being evaluated. We also introduce three metrics to measure the extent of agent hijacking at three different levels. Across 10 defense configurations for computer-use agents and 11 defense configurations for browser-use agents, our adaptive attacks achieve average success rates of 91.87% and 91.99%, respectively.
