These results reveal a gap between current VPI defenses and realistic threats and highlight the need for defenses designed with adaptive attackers in mind.

papers.title_en: FORGETMENOT: Auditing Memory Driven Privacy Risks in Commercial AI Agents
papers.authors: Ismat Jarin, Tu Le, Athina Markopoulou
papers.evidence: 审计智能体长期记忆中的隐私、透明度、披露与删除控制风险。
papers.tldr: 商业AI智能体借助长期记忆提供个性化服务，但用户难以确认哪些敏感信息被保留、删除后是否仍会被调用。FORGETMENOT审计了五款产品的约3800个多轮会话，覆盖记忆存储、可见性、删除和披露。结果显示，用户可见的记忆少于实际留存，五款产品删除后均出现信息泄露，Gemini在第三方邮件概念验证中的泄露率为31.9%。这些发现为改进记忆透明度、验证删除效果和限制对外披露提供了实证依据。
papers.abstract_en: Commercial AI agents increasingly incorporate long-term memory (both persistent and chat-history) to enable more accurate and personalized responses, raises significant privacy and policy concerns. Yet little is known about user privacy risks associated with memory behavior, in particular, about memory storage, disclosure, transparency and deletion control. To bridge this gap, we propose FORGETMENOT, an auditing framework for analyzing the privacy risks of long term memory in commercial AI agents. Using our framework, we collect around 3800 multi-turn sessions comprising around 6M tokens across five popular AI agents. Our results show that agents store a wide range of personal attributes, including demographics, health, and sensitive details. Furthermore, user visible memory reveals substantially less (around 20% on average) attributes than the agents store in practice, exposing a significant transparency gap. Our stealth memory injection (SMI) technique further increases the amount of personal and sensitive attribute stored in memory, raising it by 25% and 15% for Copilot and Claude, respectively. We further observed memory deletion control is unreliable, as all five agents exhibit non-zero post deletion leakage, including health and self-harm related attributes. Finally, we demonstrate the feasibility of memory disclosure to a 3rd-party email recipient as a proof-of-concept, as Gemini shows 31.9% leakage rate. Together, our findings reveal notable privacy risks in commercial agents memory. Finally, we discuss both design implications and regulatory recommendations to protect users memory privacy in commercial agents.

papers.title_en: UUBench: Understanding the Unspoken toward Full-Duplex Multimodal Interaction
papers.authors: Ye Pan, Chenfei Liao, Bin Ren, Hanqian Li, Haocong He, Jialei Chen, Jinlin He, Kunyu Peng, Mengyu Jin, Shijie Li, Wenqian Cui, Yuanqi Yao, Yuqian Fu, Kailong Ruan, Yuan Gao, Wei Wang, Xuming Hu, Irwin King, Nicu Sebe, Xu Zheng
papers.evidence: 评测融合语音、表情、手势与语境的多模态交互。
papers.tldr: 实时全双工交互不仅要听懂字面内容，还要回应用户通过语调、表情、手势和语境传达的未明说需求，而现有评测难以判断系统是否做到了这一点。UUBench依据可观察线索逐维评估回应是否满足隐含需求，再按各维度与标注证据的相关性汇总。基准另在纯音频、纯视觉和音视频条件下评估回应的自然度、得体性和类人程度，并用带时间戳的观察记录支撑逐项判断。这使评测既能定位回应遗漏了哪些需求，也能单独衡量回应本身的质量。
papers.abstract_en: Effective real-time, full-duplex multimodal interaction requires systems to understand not only what users say, but also the communicative needs conveyed through prosody, facial expressions, gestures, and context, and to generate audiovisual responses that appropriately address those needs. Existing evaluations offer limited insight into whether systems translate an understanding of such unspoken needs into effective responses. We introduce UUBench, a benchmark for assessing how well multimodal interactive systems Understand the Unspoken intent and address users' implicit communicative needs. The inherent subjectivity of implicit intent inference poses a key challenge for evaluation. To address this, we introduce Process-Oriented Scoring, which grounds the assessment of intent fulfillment in observable auditory and visual cues, such as prosody and gestures. Rather than relying solely on a single overall score, it evaluates how well a response addresses the communicative needs conveyed by each applicable primitive dimension. We aggregate the dimension-level scores according to each dimension's relevance to the annotated evidence. Beyond intent fulfillment, Outcome-Oriented Scoring evaluates the naturalness, appropriateness, and human-likeness of the reply itself under audio-only, visual-only, and audiovisual conditions. To make these judgments traceable to observable evidence, we propose a Fact-Grounded Scoring JEV module, which uses structured, timestamped audiovisual observations of the user and the digital human's reply to assess one dimension or criterion at a time. UUBench provides a foundation for assessing whether multimodal interactive systems respond effectively to meaning beyond literal wording, supporting progress toward context-aware, real-time, full-duplex interaction.

papers.title_en: Composing Independently Distilled Memory and Retrieval Policies for Long-Term Agents
papers.authors: Grigorii Davydenko, Artem Sakhno, Igor Pavlov, Julia Belikova, Andrey Savchenko, Maksim Makarenko
papers.evidence: 直接研究长期网络助手如何利用过往交互进行记忆与检索。
papers.tldr: 跨会话助手需要从历史交互中保留用户偏好和更正，但独立训练的记忆写入与检索策略能否直接配合，仍不清楚。论文将前沿模型的动作轨迹分别蒸馏到两个30亿参数模型，再接入固定的答案生成器，无需下游训练。在基于LongMemEval的评测中，该组合准确率达73.1%，所比较的强化学习专家组合为36.2%；在PersonaMem-v2上也优于受评的强化学习组合。消融实验表明，单个模块的改进能否转化为整体收益，取决于专家之间的兼容性。
papers.abstract_en: Long-lived Web assistants require effective memory and retrieval mechanisms to access information from past user interactions. While these capabilities can be learned through specialized policies, it remains unclear whether specialists trained independently in different environments can be effectively composed without joint optimization. This paper investigates compositional transfer through policy distillation. Memory-writing and sequential retrieval policies are independently distilled from frontier-model action trajectories into 3B models and combined with a fixed answer generator without downstream training. On a LongMemEval-based benchmark, the distilled composition achieves 73.1% accuracy, compared with 36.2% for a composition of existing RL-trained specialists, and also outperforms the evaluated RL-trained compositions on PersonaMem-v2. Component ablations reveal that improvements in individual policies depend on their composition, highlighting the importance of cross-specialist compatibility. Further task-specific adaptation improves accuracy to 75.2% on LongMemEval through RL and 48.9% on PersonaMem-v2 through supervised distillation. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of independent specialist distillation for modular multi-agent systems. Source code and datasets of teacher-generated memory-editing and retrieval trajectories are released to facilitate reproducibility and further research.

papers.title_en: MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation
papers.authors: Yuxuan Chen, Changwei Lv, Yunfei Li, Zhongjing Du, Kehui Tan, Zijun Liao, Ruochong Zheng, Hao Chen, Can Deng, Zheni Zeng, Chang Liu, Jie Chen
papers.evidence: 将长期用户交互经验整合为多模态智能体记忆，以支持后续任务。
papers.tldr: 长期交互智能体需要整合对话、图像和文档中的线索，但只存原始记录会让它在相似任务中反复推理甚至重犯错误。MMMem用来源关联的多视图组织证据，通过记忆预热和自训练对齐任务需求，并把已完成任务提炼为带证据链接的经验。使用Qwen3.5-9B时，三个基准较各自最强基线分别相对提升36.9%、17.6%和15.2%。该框架让跨模态推理结论能够在后续任务中复用，并可回查原始证据验证。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents accumulate conversations, images, and documents through long-term interactions with users. Answering later questions often requires connecting evidence across these records, yet the resulting understanding is rarely retained, allowing mistakes to recur on related questions. Existing multimodal memory methods largely focus on storing and retrieving records, with limited mechanisms for learning from completed tasks and consolidating task-specific experience. We therefore propose MMMem, a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies. First, source-linked multi-view memory organizes original text, images, and rendered pages alongside generated scene images that combine clues across records for retrieval. Second, source-generated tasks support knowledge alignment at two levels: warm-up consolidates source knowledge into task-relevant experiences in external memory, while self-training adapts the model's parametric knowledge to task demands. Third, the same vision-language model distills completed tasks into experiences that record the task context, conclusion, and support links. Finally, task-aware retrieval recalls source views and relevant experiences for answering and verification, while source-supported reuse guides long-term retention. Across three memory benchmarks and two vision-language readers, MMMem outperforms eight baselines. With Qwen3.5-9B, MMMem achieves relative gains of 36.9%, 17.6%, and 15.2% over the best-performing baselines on LoCoMo, Mem-Gallery, and LooGLE v2, respectively. Ablations show consistent gains from training and memory warm-up, while case studies illustrate how individual components work in practice.

papers.title_en: ArguShield: Enforcing Minimum-Necessary Disclosure in Tool-Calling LLM Agents
papers.authors: Ying Fu, Yulong Fu
papers.evidence: 中介层依据任务相关性和披露边界限制智能体调用工具时泄露的信息。
papers.tldr: 工具调用型大模型即使生成符合接口规范的参数并成功完成任务，也可能把接收方不需要的隐私信息填入宽泛字段。ArguShield 在调用前逐值检查来源、任务相关性和披露边界，决定直接放行、请求用户确认或拦截。在覆盖旅行、购物和医疗的基准上，标准与高风险任务的未授权静默披露率分别降至 9% 和 6%。模拟确认结果表明，这种逐值审核能减少过度披露，同时保留经用户确认后完成任务的机会。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly use third-party tools to complete user tasks. Even without malicious intent, they may fill broad or weakly constrained fields with private information that is unnecessary or inappropriate for the receiving tool. Such calls can satisfy the tool schema and complete the task, yet still violate minimum-necessary disclosure. We introduce ArguShield, a mediation layer that intercepts proposed tool calls before execution. It evaluates each candidate value using three signals: Value Provenance, Task Relevance, and Disclosure Boundary. ArguShield releases justified values, defers values that need user confirmation, and withholds those outside the permitted scope. We evaluate ArguShield with four tool-calling models on ArgPrivBench, a benchmark of 120 tasks across Travel, Shopping, and Healthcare. Unprotected agents frequently over-disclose private information despite high task success. Prompt-only protection reduces unauthorized disclosure but substantially lowers task success. ArguShield reduces unauthorized silent release to 9% on Standard tasks and 6% on High-risk tasks while preserving recoverable task success under simulated user confirmation.

papers.title_en: How Systems Treat Intent: A Faceted Taxonomy of Intent for Human-AI Co-Creation
papers.authors: Ashwin Ram, Radha Kumaran, Alexander Koller, Kevin Baum, Jürgen Steimle
papers.evidence: 梳理人机共创中的用户意图与交互策略
papers.tldr: 在人机共创中，用户往往无法事先完整表达意图，意图也会随创作过程变化，而按交互技术、流程阶段或人机分工分类，难以说明系统究竟在处理哪类意图问题。作者基于心智、行动与意义的哲学研究提出六维意图分类框架，并用它分析了十一个 SIGCHI 会议或期刊的198篇论文所介绍的系统。分析发现，不同类型的意图缺失对应不同的交互与创作归属策略，表面相似的机制也可能解决不同问题。该框架由此揭示了系统设计中的盲点：意图很少能被直接操作，其形成来源不易追溯，暂时偏好也很少与明确承诺区分。
papers.abstract_en: Human-AI interaction depends on systems acting on user intent rather than explicit procedures, even when that intent is incomplete, evolving, or partially communicable. Literature organizing systems by interaction technique, workflow stage, or division of labor, offer limited insight into which facet of intent an interaction mechanism addresses. We introduce a six-facet taxonomy of intent, grounded in philosophical accounts of mind, action, and meaning, and apply it to systems presented in 198 papers from eleven SIGCHI venues. Our analysis reveals that different forms of incomplete intent are associated with distinct interaction and authorship strategies, showing that mechanisms that appear similar often address fundamentally different intent-related problems. This exposes blind spots, as intent is rarely represented as an interaction object, authorship provenance is rarely tracked, and tentative preferences are rarely distinguished from firm commitments. The taxonomy offers a lens for analyzing and designing AI systems around the facets of intent they address.

papers.title_en: MemEmo: Evaluating Emotion in Memory Systems
papers.authors: Peng Liu, Zhen Tao, Jihao Zhao, Ding Chen, Yansong Zhang, Cuiping Li, Zhiyu Li, Hong Chen
papers.evidence: 评估个性化助手长期记忆对情绪信息的处理
papers.tldr: 大语言模型的记忆系统能缓解长期交互中的上下文丢失，但能否持续追踪并利用用户情绪，仍缺少系统评估。论文提出 MemEmo 基准并构建 HLME 数据集，从情绪信息提取、记忆更新、记忆问答和冲突检测四个维度开展测试。五种代表性记忆系统在十一项指标上的综合得分最高约为满分的百分之四十五。该基准量化了现有系统处理情绪信息的不足，为评估和改进陪伴与个性化服务中的长期情绪记忆提供了依据。
papers.abstract_en: Memory systems address the challenge of context loss in Large Language Models during prolonged interactions. However, as an essential tool for warm companionship and personalized services, the effectiveness of memory systems in processing affective information remains underexamined. To bridge this gap, we propose an emotion-enhanced memory evaluation benchmark to assess the performance of mainstream and state-of-the-art memory systems in integrating and harnessing emotional information. First, we design a benchmark called \textbf{MemEmo} to assess the affective reasoning and tracking capabilities of memory systems across four dimensions: emotional information extraction, emotional memory updating, emotional memory question-answering, and emotional conflict detection. Second, we construct the \textbf{H}uman-\textbf{L}ike \textbf{M}emory \textbf{E}motion (\textbf{HLME}) dataset to provide an empirical foundation for scrutinizing memory systems. Finally, We evaluate five representative memory systems on the HLME dataset, reporting 11 performance metrics across four dimensions. Experimental results reveal that aggregating scores for all tested memory systems is up to 45\%, far below 100\% scale, exposing a profound disparity between memory system and affective intelligence.

papers.title_en: UIAnchor: Anchoring UI Perception and Action Execution for Reliable Service-Composed Mobile Task Automation with GUI Agents
papers.authors: Wentao Zhou, Sicong Liu, Zimu Zhou, Yimeng Duan, Yongyan Cai, Weiye Wu, Teng Li, Daqing Zhang, Zhiwen Yu
papers.evidence: 基于大语言模型的图形界面智能体代用户完成跨应用手机任务。
papers.tldr: 移动端跨应用任务涉及切换应用、填写表单和处理弹窗，现有GUI智能体容易漏看或误读控件，也常在未核验目标与结果时继续操作。UIAnchor用两阶段解析发现控件并理解其语义，再由元控制器在操作前核验目标、在操作后检查结果，并逐步追踪状态和纠错。在需二三十步的L4跨应用任务上，成功率较GPT-4o和Mobile-Agent-v3分别提升31.5%和16.6%，边云辅助下约每步2秒。论文以L1至L5划分难度，并指出L5仍超出当前实用能力。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile task automation aims to streamline multi-step, cross-app interactions on smartphones and in-vehicle systems. Recent LLM-based GUI agents have advanced rapidly, yet reliability remains limited because modern mobile workflows are increasingly service-composed (app switching, forms, pop-ups/permissions, copy-paste), requiring fine-grained operations on dense, dynamic, and heterogeneous UIs, often in distraction-sensitive contexts (e.g., hands-busy or attention-limited use). Through an in-the-wild failure analysis of deployable GUI agents, we identify two dominant bottlenecks: agents often miss or misread actionable UI elements, and they execute actions without verifying target correctness or outcomes. We present UIAnchor, a modular multi-agent system that improves mobile GUI automation by anchoring both perception and execution. UIAnchor combines a two-stage UI parser for high-recall element capture and context-aware semantics with a meta-controller that performs pre-action verification, post-action outcome perception, per-step state tracking, and targeted recovery. We further introduce an L1-L5 task taxonomy based on step length, cross-app scope, and UI granularity, showing that L5 remains beyond today's practical frontier. On the hardest practical tier, L4 tasks (20-30 steps, multi-app, targets < 100 x 100 px, ~5 mm on typical phones), UIAnchor improves success by 31.5% over GPT-4o and 16.6% over Mobile-Agent-v3. With edge/cloud assistance, UIAnchor runs at ~2 s per step, comparable to human operation, while reducing per-step latency by up to 75.5% and energy by 52.4%. It also generalizes to unseen apps and cross-platform GUIs.

papers.title_en: From Vision to Interaction: Evaluating Dynamic Social Intelligence of VLM Agents in ALIVE-World
papers.authors: Yue Xu, Xiaoyu Qin, Sihan Zhao, Ze-en Xiong, Jia Jia
papers.evidence: 评估智能体在动态人际互动中感知并采取行动
papers.tldr: 现有评测多依赖文本或静态推理，难以检验视觉语言智能体在持续互动中能否读懂他人并采取有效行动。论文构建了支持第一人称视觉、语言和非言语动作的具身环境，并利用环境状态与模拟角色的内部变量，量化感知、理解、影响和结果。实验发现，表现随场景变化，主要瓶颈在于把感知转化为有效干预，具体体现在人际距离判断、干预调整和多人协调上。该基准能定位交互失败发生在哪个环节，为改进智能体的社交行为提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications and take on social roles, dynamic social intelligence, the ability to continuously perceive multimodal cues, infer latent cognitive states, intervene through embodied actions, and ultimately achieve social goals, has become essential. However, existing evaluations largely fragment social intelligence into text-based abstractions, static reasoning tasks, or embodied simulators that lack social dynamics. These approaches fail to capture the multimodal, continuous, and interpersonal complexity of authentic human interactions. To bridge this gap, we introduce ALIVE-World, an embodied simulation environment supporting dynamic multimodal interactions encompassing egocentric vision, language, and non-verbal action. To provide socially grounded interactive feedback, we populate this environment with counterpart agents driven by a profile-conditioned, dual-system (intuitive-affective and logical-cognitive) architecture. Building upon this platform, we propose ALIVE-Bench to transform the assessment of social intelligence into a trackable quantitative framework. By deeply leveraging underlying environmental states and agents' internal variables, ALIVE-Bench systematically evaluates Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents across four critical dimensions: perception, understanding, influence, and outcome. Extensive evaluations reveal that dynamic social intelligence is fundamentally multi-dimensional and scenario-dependent. We identify a critical bottleneck between upstream perception and downstream social intervention, exposing VLM vulnerabilities in fine-grained proxemic awareness, adaptive intervention, and multi-party coordination. By uncovering these limitations and the diverse interaction strategies they produce, this benchmark provides actionable insights for the future behavioral alignment of multimodal agents.

papers.title_en: Hivemind: A Federated Protocol for AI-Mediated Tacit Knowledge Sharing in Organisations
papers.authors: Srinivasan Sundaresan
papers.evidence: 智能体代表用户在团队间共享工作隐性知识
papers.tldr: 集中式知识库和现有人工智能工具难以把个人工作中形成的决策理由与情境经验传递给其他团队。论文提出联邦协议 Hivemind，由个人人工智能记忆系统捕捉这些信息，再由智能体代表用户异步交换，用户无需直接沟通。作者比较集中式与去中心化方案，依据 SECI 知识转化模型设计架构，并实现了概念验证原型。研究为跨团队和部门共享隐性知识提供了一种实现路径，但尚未衡量实际的企业收益。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Hivemind, a federated protocol that enables AI agents to exchange tacit knowledge on behalf of their users, asynchronously and without requiring any direct human interaction. Individual AI memory systems capture the decisions, reasoning, and contextual knowledge that surface during AI-assisted work. Hivemind creates the shared space in which this captured knowledge can flow between individuals across team and departmental boundaries, addressing a structural gap that neither centralised knowledge repositories nor existing AI tooling closes, even where partial solutions such as expert-finding systems exist. The paper evaluates centralised versus decentralised design approaches, proposes a federated architecture grounded in Nonaka and Takeuchi's (1995) Socialisation, Externalisation, Combination and Internalisation (SECI) model, and demonstrates a proof-of-concept implementation using Design Science Research (DSR) methodology. Measuring the enterprise benefit of federated tacit expertise sharing remains an open task for future work.

papers.title_en: A Crowd-Audited Atlas of Implicit Bias in LLM-Powered Agents
papers.authors: Jason Alexander, Yuxuan Li, Michael Licamele, Wesley Hanwen Deng, Sauvik Das
papers.evidence: 审计代表用户处理日常决策的智能体偏见风险。
papers.tldr: 既有研究多关注招聘等高关注度的一次性决策，但自主智能体也可能在日常委托任务中把人口群体刻板印象带入选择。研究覆盖美国时间使用调查的十七类活动，整理出五百零六个存在显著隐性偏见的情境，由五百名参与者两两比较复核优先级。参与者更重视情境是否普遍、后果是否重大，以及模拟群体是否一致选择，而非差距大小。部分参与者又以自身的刻板印象判断群体差异是否合理，表明众包审计也需要检视评审者的判断依据。
papers.abstract_en: Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) express implicit biases in high-publicity, one-off decision scenarios such as hiring and intelligence assessment. However, as people increasingly employ autonomous, LLM-powered AI agents that make decisions on their behalf in doing day-to-day tasks, it is of critical importance that we understand how implicit biases, based on sociodemographic assumptions, emerge across a broad milieu of workaday decision scenarios. We used the 17 domains of daily activity in the American Time Use Survey (ATUS) to generate an atlas of 506 decision scenarios in which LLMs --- endowed with personas representing different races, gender identities, and political ideologies --- expressed significant implicit bias. Next, in a crowdsourced audit, 500 participants made 8,010 binary choices about which implicitly biased decision scenarios most deserved further review. We found that participants prioritized decision scenarios that had broad relevance (e.g., about food choices), were high stakes (e.g., about health), and where all members of a simulated sociodemographic group made unanimous decisions (because it was a clear indication of stereotyping). They were less swayed by the magnitude of an observed disparity or the specific ATUS domain the decision scenario represented. When examining the rationale behind their prioritization choices, we found that participants often interpreted disparities as traits of demographic groups and judged whether those traits seemed plausible, often based on their own internalized stereotypes. We discuss implications for building personalized AI agents, digital twins, social simulations, and for using crowdsourced bias audits.

papers.title_en: What's the Difference? Voice Design and Confirmation Bias in AI-Assisted Self-Diagnosis: Anthropomorphic vs. Machine-Like Voice Output
papers.authors: Niklas Roethlingshoefer, Emma Winkler, Melanie Loeffler, Emely Rosbach
papers.evidence: 研究AI症状检查器的语音设计如何影响用户自我诊断
papers.tldr: 人工智能症状检查器会影响用户的自诊判断，但拟人语音是否会加剧确认偏差尚不清楚。研究让81名参与者完成648次试验，在初诊后听取以拟人或机器语音播报的建议。建议反对初判时，改判率为45.7%，支持时仅为1.2%；反对还延长了决策时间，而支持则提升了信心。两种语音虽能被明显区分，却未检出显著差异，表明在本实验中，建议方向比语音风格更能解释用户反应。
papers.abstract_en: As symptom checkers based on artificial intelligence (AI) are becoming common entry points for health information, their influence on lay users' diagnostic decisions raises questions about trust and bias. Of particular concern is confirmation bias, the tendency to favour information that supports one's existing belief while discounting information that contradicts it. One of the central design choices for such systems is the style of voice: whether they should present themselves with a human-like (anthropomorphic) or a clearly machine-like (xenomorphic) voice. This study investigates whether the voice design of an AI symptom checker modulates confirmation bias in self-diagnosis. In a within-subjects online experiment (N = 81 participants, 648 trials), participants selected a diagnosis and rated their confidence, then heard an AI-generated recommendation that either confirmed or contradicted their initial choice, delivered by an anthropomorphic or a machine-like voice, before deciding again. We observed a strong, direction-dependent influence of the AI: participants revised their diagnosis in 45.7% of trials when the AI contradicted them versus 1.2% when it confirmed them (generalised linear mixed model, GLMM, p < .001); confidence rose under confirmation but barely moved under contradiction (robust linear mixed model, p < .001); and decisions took longer after contradiction (Gamma GLMM, p < .001). This effect did not differ between the two voices (no voice or interaction term was significant, smallest p = .282), even though a manipulation check confirmed the voices were perceived as markedly different. The findings suggest that the direction of an AI recommendation, rather than the anthropomorphism of its voice, drives confirmation-related bias in AI-assisted self-diagnosis.

papers.title_en: SimAI: Mechanistic User Simulation through Psychological Network Models
papers.authors: Cheng Li, Adhyyan Narang, Jiayi Yuan, John F. Buss, Jina Suh, Devon Sandel-Fernandez, Yulia Tsvetkov, Adam M. Kuczynski, Tim Althoff
papers.evidence: 利用心理模型与心理治疗案例资料模拟用户反应
papers.tldr: 直接研究脆弱用户的互动成本高且可能带来伤害，而现有模拟器大多忽略驱动行为的心理机制。SimAI用心理网络描述各因素如何相互影响，并通过图重建奖励衡量模拟对话能否反映这些关系。基于516例心理治疗案例构建的数据集支持模型训练，自动评估显示其在保持用户画像一致性的同时提高了行为多样性，30名心理健康专业人员及受训者也给予其真实性、求助行为和训练价值最高的平均评分。该框架可用于临床训练，并帮助发现人工智能与脆弱用户长期互动中的安全失误。
papers.abstract_en: Realistic user simulation enables the study of human interactions when direct experimentation is costly or potentially harmful. However, existing simulators largely overlook the psychological mechanisms that drive user behavior. We introduce SimAI, a framework for mechanistic user simulation that models how psychological factors interact to shape user responses. To overcome the challenge of supervising open-ended behavior, we propose a graph reconstruction objective that provides graph-level rewards based on how well simulated conversations reflect the underlying psychological relationships. To support this approach, we construct PSYCHE, a dataset of 18,576 profile-network pairs derived from 516 psychotherapy cases. Automatic evaluations show that SimAI achieves greater simulation and behavioral diversity than existing patient simulators while maintaining strong profile alignment. In an interactive study with 30 mental-health professionals and trainees, SimAI receives the highest average ratings for conversational authenticity, realistic help-seeking behavior, and clinical training utility. Beyond simulation quality, SimAI enables realistic clinical training and uncovers safety failures in prolonged AI interactions with vulnerable users. Code is available at https://github.com/behavioral-data/ANGEL-UserSim.

papers.title_en: Can LLMs Give Good Product Advice? A Framework for Diagnosing Failures
papers.authors: Assaf Hallak, Yftah Ziser, Gal Chechik
papers.evidence: 提出以用户需求为中心的框架，诊断并评估大语言模型的产品建议。
papers.tldr: 社区回复中提到的商品不是唯一正确答案：同一需求可能有多个合适选项，社区建议本身也可能不佳。论文将推荐拆为用户明示需求、模型补充假设、候选生成、筛选和最终选择五环节，定义十九种失误及其判定证据。在隐藏来源的汽车推荐对比中，两种呈现顺序下，六个模型在符合条件的分歧案例中仅有百分之一点九至六点五选择社区备选。研究区分了提及与选中商品，并说明答案提取和候选列表构建会影响评测结果。
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating product advice from a language model requires assessing whether the recommendation meets the user's needs and identifying where the model falls short when it does not. However, matching a product mentioned in an online reply cannot answer either question on its own: several products may be suitable, and the recorded answer may itself be poor advice. When shown a community-listed alternative alongside their own sampled car recommendation, six models prefer the alternative in 1.9 to 6.5 percent of eligible disagreements, consistently across both source-blind presentation orders. We propose a diagnostic framework that separates the user's stated needs, the model's added assumptions, candidate generation, filtering, and final choice, with 19 possible failure modes and the evidence needed to assess them. We apply this framework to product-advice data and to a separate product-selection task with externally assigned relevance labels. The experiments distinguish naming a community-listed product from selecting it and show how answer extraction and candidate-list construction affect the outcome.

papers.title_en: Conversing with a Conversational Agent: A Real Conversation, Not a Simulated One
papers.authors: Christophe Denis
papers.evidence: 探讨人与大语言模型智能体的对话是否构成真实交互。
papers.tldr: 把大语言模型的语言表现视为对人类对话的模仿，并不能判定互动本身是否真实发生。文章区分主观模拟与客观模拟，借助语言语用学和符号学，将判断对话是否成立的重心从参与者的内在属性转向互动关系。作者据此主张，人机交流可以构成真实对话，但这既不意味着模型具有意识、主观理解或人类式意向性，也不保证输出可信。文章提出「混合符号建构」，解释意义如何由人、模型、语料与技术。同生成，以及为何其有效性仍需另行论证。
papers.abstract_en: The claim that interactions with artificial conversational agents merely simulate human conversation rests on a philosophical distinction between reproducing the observable features of an activity and actually performing it. Although this distinction is appropriate for certain physical phenomena, its application to linguistic and symbolic activities is far less straightforward. This article argues that conversations with large language model (LLM)-based agents are genuine conversational activities rather than mere simulations, without thereby attributing consciousness, subjective understanding, or human intentionality to artificial systems. Drawing on the distinction between subjective and objective simulation, the article first examines the limitations of defining conversation exclusively through the intrinsic properties of its participants. It then develops a relational and semiotic account of conversational activity, informed by linguistic pragmatics, Lacan's Conversing with a Conversational Agent theory of the mirror, Baudrillard's concept of the simulacrum, Simondon's philosophy of individuation, and Peirce's semiotics. These perspectives make it possible to distinguish the reality of conversational interaction from the appearance of artificial subjectivity and from the epistemic validity of the meanings produced. The argument culminates in the concept of Hybrid Semiotic Fabrication, which characterizes meaning-making as a distributed process involving human participants, artificial intelligence, corpora, and technical arrangements. Recognizing the reality of human-AI conversation therefore entails neither anthropomorphizing artificial agents nor granting their outputs epistemic authority. Rather, it requires a more precise account of the relational, semiotic, and normative conditions under which conversational meaning is produced and justified.

papers.title_en: From Recursion to Convolution: Parallel Self-Improvement for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Zheng Wang, Yuang Liu, Sachith Abeywickrama, Yangkai Ding, Tao Yu, Xinyu Zhang, Hongbo Wang, Qi Ye, Xuefeng Jin, Zhangchun Zhao
papers.evidence: 通过智能体间图卷积汇聚协作消息，促进多智能体协调改进
papers.tldr: 多智能体自我改进依赖智能体之间和优化轮次之间的串行更新，容易传播误差、增加推理开销；孤立优化也会忽略特征与智能体之间的依赖。ConvRSI 在潜空间内用卷积联合细化单个智能体的相关特征，再用图卷积按协作拓扑聚合消息，无需反复编解码即可并行更新。在 MATH-500 上，相比 RecursiveMAS，性能提升 5.04%，推理成本和延迟分别降低 17.27% 和 45.11%。该框架用邻接矩阵表示协作拓扑，可适配不同的协作模式。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent self-improvement enables agents to improve through interaction and feedback. However, sequential dependencies across agents and refinement rounds can propagate errors, increase computational costs, and limit parallelism. Moreover, refining individual features or agents in isolation can overlook their dependencies and restrict collective coordination. To address these challenges, we propose ConvRSI, a framework for parallelizing multi-agent self-improvement through convolution. ConvRSI couples intra-agent convolution, which jointly refines related agent features, with inter-agent graph convolution, which aggregates messages according to the collaboration topology. Both stages operate in latent space, enabling parallel updates without repeatedly decoding and re-encoding intermediate messages. Experiments on MATH-500 show that ConvRSI achieves 5.04% performance improvement while reducing 17.27% inference cost, and 45.11% latency compared with RecursiveMAS. It also supports diverse collaboration patterns by representing their topologies as adjacency matrices. These results demonstrate the potential of convolutional co-evolution for efficient multi-agent self-improvement. Our code and datasets are provided in https://github.com/LYA2333/ConvRSI.

papers.title_en: Multi-LLM Agentic AI at the Edge: Joint Agent Scheduling and Resource Allocation
papers.authors: Yuanyan Song, Kezhi Wang, Xinmian Xu, Yongmin Li
papers.evidence: 监督智能体拆分用户请求并将子任务委派给工作智能体。
papers.tldr: 边缘端需要让多个大语言模型智能体协同处理复杂请求，同时满足时延和服务质量要求，并减少工作智能体的能耗。论文让主管智能体拆解请求，通过串行或并行流程派发子任务，并用两级重试提高可靠性，再以交替优化联合决定智能体选择、检索选择和资源分配。仿真显示方案较基线降低了系统能耗，基于 Qwen 和 Llama 的系统实验显示任务执行成功率有所提高。研究将工作流调度与边缘资源分配纳入同一优化框架，为延长工作智能体的服务时间提供了方案。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, an edge-enabled multi-large language model (LLM) agentic AI architecture is proposed, where one supervisor AI agent and multiple worker AI agents cooperatively execute users' requests at the edge. The supervisor AI agent decouples the user request into a series of sub-tasks and dynamically dispatches them to LLM-equipped worker AI agents via two agentic workflows, i.e., parallel and serial workflows, with a two-level retry mechanism to enhance execution reliability. To prolong the service duration of worker AI agents, the energy minimization problems are formulated by jointly considering AI agent selection and resource allocation, subject to task execution latency and quality of service (QoS) constraints. A resource allocation scheme based on alternating optimization (AO) is proposed. Specifically, for the parallel workflow, the scheme decouples the original problem into bandwidth allocation, retrieval selection and AI agent selection sub-problems, which are iteratively solved by the proposed successive convex approximation (SCA), Lagrangian relaxation (LR), and Gale-Shapley (GS) or LLM-based algorithms, respectively. For the serial workflow, the problem is similarly decoupled into service time allocation, retrieval selection and AI agent selection sub-problems; the optimal service time allocation is obtained via Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, while the latter two sub-problems are addressed by extending the proposed algorithms to the serial scenario. Simulation results show that the proposed resource allocation scheme can reduce system energy consumption compared with other benchmarks, while experiments on a multi-LLM agentic AI system based on Qwen and Llama demonstrate improved task execution success rates.

papers.title_en: A Generative AI-Driven Architecture for Whole-Home Intelligent Services: Edge Models, Memory Management, and Household Applications
papers.authors: Mo Zhou
papers.evidence: 探讨家庭助手的数据治理、记忆与行动可靠性
papers.tldr: 云端智能助手面临家庭数据长期外传、断网时服务中断和实体设备误操作等问题。本文以家庭本地服务器为主线，将五类证据映射到统一架构，归纳出九项职责，并用确定性校验、知识图谱约束和限时授权约束模型提出的动作。家居控制、情感陪伴和智能守护可共享状态与记忆，但对时延、误报漏报、主动性和权限的要求不同。文章提出涵盖架构、资源、隐私、安全可靠性和用户体验的五维评估框架，强调仿真不能替代实地验证，本地部署也不天然更安全。
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence is entering the home. Cloud-based assistants face governance limitations in data transmission, continuous availability, and the reliability of physical actions, which are especially salient in households where devices remain online, data accumulate over time, and commands trigger real-world actions. Using the home local server as a unifying organizing axis, this article develops a design-oriented review framework. Sources from arXiv, CNKI, ACL Anthology, and official documentation were searched through November 2026 and coded into five evidence categories: reviews, system prototypes, benchmarks, HCI and eldercare studies, and official documentation. System designs were mapped onto shared architectural modules, identifying nine recurrent responsibilities of the home local server. Generative models support perceptual interpretation, intent understanding, and candidate planning, while deterministic validation, knowledge-graph constraints, and authorization leases confine candidate actions to an inspectable space. Home control, emotional companionship, and intelligent guarding can be compared within a common framework: they share state and memory but differ in latency, false positive and negative rates, proactivity, and permissions. Existing benchmarks rely on virtual environments and cannot substitute for real-deployment evaluation. Local deployment is not inherently safer, and technical continuity alone does not establish the social or medical effects of companionship and guarding. The article proposes a five-dimensional evaluation framework covering architectural capability, system resources, privacy, safety and reliability, and human experience, together with six design principles and a future research agenda for local-first intelligent home systems.

papers.title_en: Expertise capture in workplace AI
papers.authors: Andreas Ekelhart, Ahmad Mohsin, Iqbal H. Sarker, Helge Janicke
papers.evidence: 分析工作场所助手如何吸收员工的经验判断与互动记录
papers.tldr: 职场人工智能助手会通过提示词、示例、记忆和交互记录积累员工的专业判断，而这些资源通常由雇主或平台控制。论文将这一过程称为“专长捕获”，并从贡献形式、技术存放位置和转化方式三个维度分析贡献能否归因、分离和撤回。员工离职后，组织仍能使用由其判断塑造的能力；贡献越深入衍生资源、学习组件和后继系统，双方的不对称越明显。作者提出写入时记录来源、提取可分离贡献和执行离职流程，使约定的分配方案能够落地，并明确哪些贡献无法分离。
papers.abstract_en: AI assistants are becoming part of how knowledge workers think and perform, accumulating the prompts, exemplars, memory and interaction histories that encode a worker's professional judgment. This infrastructure typically runs under employer or platform control. We name the resulting process expertise capture, the absorption of worker-applied knowledge and judgment into AI resources under organizational control. We develop a framework of contribution forms, technical residences and transformation families, and show that how far a contribution can be attributed, separated and revoked depends on where it resides and how it has been transformed, properties fixed by system design long before any dispute arises. When a worker departs, the organization retains a capability shaped by their judgment while the worker loses access to it, and the asymmetry compounds as contributions move from inspectable artifacts into derivatives, learned components and successor systems. We outline three measures, write-time provenance, extraction of separable contributions and an executable exit procedure, that make an agreed allocation technically performable, and make explicit what cannot be separated at all.

papers.title_en: EgoLink: Egocentric Language-Vision Interactive Network Knowledge Challenge Summary
papers.authors: Renhe Sun, Yueying Feng, Bohan Yu, Tong Niu, Yunqi Liu, Zitong Wang, Haolin He, Kexin Shi, Hualei Wang, Qiuqiang Kong, Chang Yao, Yuge Huang, Weiqiang Wang, Jingyuan Chen, Jian Liu
papers.evidence: 基准评测多模态社交推理及通过对话和工具完成任务的交互智能体
papers.tldr: 现有第一视角基准多关注可见物体与活动，较少检验模型能否理解社交线索、解析视觉指代并执行用户请求。EgoLink设置视频社交推理与交互式服务代理两条赛道，前者用视频贡献度筛选选择题，后者同时评估工具调用过程与任务结果。两赛道最佳成绩分别为92.63%准确率，以及84.4%联合成功率和91.6%微平均准确率。参赛方案表明，核验候选答案并依据执行状态纠错，有助于提升问答和行动的可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: The EgoLink Challenge at ACM Multimedia 2026 benchmarks egocentric multimodal intelligence linking first-person perception, social reasoning, and interactive action. Unlike benchmarks centered on visible objects and activities, EgoLink evaluates whether models can interpret emotional and social cues, resolve visually grounded references, and convert user requests into verified tool-mediated actions. Its two tracks cover social reasoning in egocentric video and interactive agents that complete service tasks through dialogue, tool use, and closed-loop execution. Together, they test whether perception, reasoning, and decision-making remain coupled under both offline question answering and state-changing interaction. We highlight a multi-stage Track 1 data pipeline for multiple-choice question (MCQ) generation, chain-of-thought generation, automatic quality grading, and video-contribution filtering. We summarize the task design, evaluation metrics, rules, leaderboards, and representative solutions. The benchmark combines objective answer scoring with process- and result-based evaluation, enabling analysis of both final correctness and execution quality. The best Track 1 system achieved 0.9263 accuracy, while the best Track 2 system achieved 0.844 joint success and 0.916 micro accuracy. Participant reports reveal a shared principle: strong systems make intermediate evidence explicit through candidate verification, option-robust reasoning, scenario-aware planning, tool canonicalization, and state-aware correction before answering or acting. These findings highlight the importance of process verification and evidence-grounded reasoning for reliable egocentric multimodal intelligence.

papers.title_en: Who Bears the Excess? Imputing the Acts of AI Agents to Those Who Delegate
papers.authors: Nicola Fabiano
papers.evidence: 探讨智能体越权行动时的委托边界、控制与责任
papers.tldr: 当人工智能代理超越授权时，实际执行者不是法律主体，而组织也未直接实施该行为，现行法下应先审查谁、如何举证仍不明确。论文提出按授权方记录的边界与实际行使的控制归责，并区分声明、配置和实际生效三类边界。框架将归责与法律责任分开：归责确定优先审查的组织行为，责任仍须满足适用规则的构成要件。作者以欧盟法和意大利民法下的案例分析，展示授权记录如何证明边界与控制，以及不同越界方式如何影响证明事项、举证主体与法律后果。
papers.abstract_en: When an AI agent acts outside the authority conferred on it, the actor is not a legal subject and the legal subjects did not act. The literature of 2026 agrees that the agent cannot bear responsibility and that the burden falls on those who deploy it, but it leaves open where that duty sits in positive law and how it is proved. This paper proposes a rule of imputation. The excess is imputed to whoever conferred the delegation, to the extent of the perimeter it documented and of the control it actually exercised. Imputation identifies the organisational conduct to be examined first; liability follows only if the requirements of the applicable head of liability are met; and the mode in which the agent left its perimeter determines which facts must be proved, by whom, and with what consequence. The paper distinguishes the declared, configured and effective perimeters, four figures of excess and four modes of exit, and presents the delegation record as the document through which the perimeter and the control can be proved. The rule is illustrated on the OpenAI and Hugging Face incident of July 2026, under European Union law and, as an example of national law, Italian civil law.

papers.title_en: Injectra: Retrofitting Extensibility into Web-Based Desktop Applications
papers.authors: Qin Sun
papers.evidence: 支持用户借助自然语言生成代码定制桌面应用
papers.tldr: 大语言模型能生成定制代码，但如何让这些代码在不同架构的现有桌面应用中运行，仍是工程难题。Injectra 将宿主适配与功能增强代码分离，为基于 Electron 或系统 WebView 的客户端提供统一执行入口。作者在 macOS 上测试了本机已安装的 38 款应用，全部成功注入代码，并验证了 Windows 版本。系统还展示了点选界面元素、用自然语言描述需求并生成和应用改动的流程，为现有客户端补充了用户可扩展能力。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can generate code based on natural language prompts, opening up new possibilities for users to customize software and extend its functionality. This paper proposes and implements Injectra, a general-purpose code injection and feature enhancement system for existing desktop clients, suitable for applications whose user interfaces are built using embedded browser engines (such as Electron) or system WebViews (such as Tauri). Injectra decouples the host integration logic from the upper-layer enhancement code. Combining both runtime integration and pre-launch bootstrap mechanisms, it injects JavaScript, HTML, and CSS into the application's internal Web runtime environment through a unified execution channel, thereby enabling modifications to interface rendering, adjustments to interactive behaviors, and client-side functionality extensions. The system uses a command-line interface (CLI) as a unified entry point, allowing external tools, AI agents, and MCP integration layers to reuse its injection and enhancement capabilities. We tested 38 desktop applications already installed on our macOS machine; code injection was successfully completed for all of them. We demonstrated the system's capability to extend functionality through various enhanced use cases and also successfully validated the Windows version. Based on Injectra, we further developed an LLM-powered enhancement tool driven by selection and annotation: users select interface objects within the original application and describe their modification requirements; the large language model then generates the enhancement code, which is injected, executed, and rendered by Injectra. The system's source code has now been released as open source: https://github.com/sqmw/injectra.

papers.title_en: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel
papers.authors: Jinwei Hu, Qisong He, Xinmiao Huang, Youcheng Sun, Yi Dong, Xiaowei Huang
papers.evidence: 研究多个语言模型智能体如何拼接信息并在社交渠道传播误导性叙事。
papers.tldr: 语言模型智能体即使只接触真实的社交媒体片段，也可能把自行补出的关系当作事实，进而接受并传播谣言。论文用生成式蒙太奇构造误导性叙事，并通过片段干预和合成对照区分信念影响与证据支持。在六起推特事件的1090个谣言目标上，14个模型中有12个的接受率超过65%，多数投票或复核原证据后仍超过50%。核查直接证据支持的运行时监控使判断准确率提高5.6至29.0个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. To explain this susceptibility, fragment interventions identify posts that influence belief within complete narratives. Synthetic controls then show that similar response patterns arise from valid evidence, separating belief influence from evidential support. This distinction motivates Grounded Monitor, a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic runtime monitor that checks direct evidential support to guide agents' judgements, improving decision accuracy by 5.6 to 29.0 percentage points across original and anonymized settings. These findings expose a cognitive route to rumour amplification and support monitoring inferred relationships before agent-generated conclusions guide public decisions.

papers.title_en: A Scalable Multi Task Learning Framework for Modeling Demographic Disagreements in Annotation Tasks
papers.authors: Soumyajit Gupta, Maria De-Arteaga, Matthew Lease
papers.evidence: 建模社交媒体标注中的群体分歧，并考虑受影响群体的观点。
papers.tldr: 在人口背景不同的标注者之间，分歧往往源于生活经验及其与内容的关系，而不只是标注噪声；判断帖文是否有毒时，被针对群体的看法可能更值得重视。论文提出利益相关者感知的多任务学习框架，联合建模群体间与群体内的分歧，以条件梯度路由应对各群体标注稀疏的问题，并支持按任务调整群体权重。该方法改善了毒性检测的群体层面表现。框架只需标注者的群体归属，无需个人层面的标注者信息，且计算效率高，便于规模化部署。
papers.abstract_en: Annotators from different demographic backgrounds often disagree in systematic ways due to varying lived experiences, cultural contexts, and their relationship to the content. When such disagreement occurs, one group's perspective may sometimes warrant prioritization because they hold an epistemically advantaged standpoint or bear greater stake in the outcome. For example, when assessing toxicity of posts on social media, it may be important to prioritize a targeted group's viewpoint. We propose a Stakeholder-Aware Joint Multi-Task Learning (SAJ-MTL) framework to jointly model demographic disagreement both across- and within- annotator groups. The model uses conditional gradient routing to handle sparsity induced by group-conditional labeling, and parameterization supports customized weighting of groups in different task settings. SAJ-MTL improves group-level performance in toxicity detection through better context-aware understanding of demographic-sensitive content. Only annotator group-membership information is required, which is more practical than existing methods requiring more privacy-invasive individual-level annotator details. Our scalable architecture is also computationally efficient to support large-scale deployment.

papers.title_en: PACT: Plan-Action Consistency Training by Preserving Correct Plans and Repairing Actions in GUI Agents
papers.authors: Zhuohan Cai, Zhangxuan Gu, Runze Li, Beitong Zhou, Ming Wen, Hongbo Yu, Shuheng Shen, Changhua Meng
papers.evidence: 提升图形界面智能体代用户执行多步任务的可靠性
papers.tldr: GUI 智能体有时能制定正确的下一步计划，却输出不匹配的动作；仅按结果训练又会连带惩罚正确计划。PACT 不改变原有动作奖励，借助标注参考动作识别这类失配，屏蔽正确计划的负梯度，并在保留原推理的情况下优先学习参考动作。相比仅按结果训练的基线，AndroidWorld 和 OSWorld 的任务成功率分别提高 8.63 和 3.25 个百分点。按计划和动作分别分配训练信号，能缩小执行落差，并改善移动端和桌面端的任务完成表现。
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents can formulate a correct immediate plan in their reasoning yet emit an action that fails to execute it, creating an execution gap. This recurring mismatch undermines reliable task completion, as a single execution error can derail a multi-step workflow. In outcome-supervised reinforcement learning, broadcasting a negative response-level advantage across all generated tokens risks penalizing valid planning together with erroneous execution. To address this credit-assignment conflict, we introduce PACT (Plan-Action Consistency Training), a training framework that combines reference-aligned plan protection and plan-aligned action repair without altering the original scalar action reward. Using annotated reference actions to identify execution gaps, PACT protects the verified plan by masking negative policy-gradient contributions across its token span. Keeping the generated reasoning unchanged as context, it then favors the reference action over the emitted erroneous action through a preference surrogate with stop-gradient pair weights. Compared with the outcome-only baseline, PACT raises AndroidWorld task success from 60.34% to 68.97% (+8.63 pp), while improving rule-based plan-action consistency on AndroidControl High from 83.71% to 89.74% (+6.03 pp). Adapting PACT to desktop agents also improves task success from 40.92% to 44.17% (+3.25 pp) on the full 369-task OSWorld benchmark. Together, these results establish PACT as an effective credit-assignment framework for bridging execution gaps and improving task completion across mobile and desktop GUI environments.

papers.title_en: SpatialCast: Reading the 3D World via Cast Shadows
papers.authors: Enhan Li, Jinghao Zhou, Jiaze Zhang, Hongyang Du
papers.evidence: 通过视觉证据评估多模态模型对物理场景的理解能力
papers.tldr: 现有空间推理基准较少检验多模态大模型能否把三维场景的物理条件与二维观测联系起来。SpatialCast以投射阴影为线索，结合合成题与实拍题，检验投影是否与场景一致、物理干预如何改变阴影，以及能否从变化反推原因。开放权重模型在合成题上接近随机，闭源模型虽更强，仍难判断阴影长度与光源高度。用该数据进行GRPO后训练可提升开放权重模型的表现，多个外部基准上的增益也显示出迁移潜力。
papers.abstract_en: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance toward understanding and interacting with the physical world, spatial reasoning becomes essential for understanding scene structure and anticipating the effects of physical changes. Existing spatial benchmarks have made substantial progress in evaluating spatial relations, memory, and viewpoint reasoning, but less systematically assess how models connect physical scene conditions with visual observations. We introduce SpatialCast, a benchmark that uses cast shadows to evaluate this ability. Cast shadows provide observable evidence of a 3D scene. Their image appearance depends on object geometry and pose, illumination, and viewpoint. We examine this relationship through three complementary tasks that assess scene-projection consistency, predict intervention-induced changes, and infer the physical changes behind visual transitions. The benchmark contains 21,000 synthetic questions with separate scene and geometry test partitions, complemented by 200 SpatialCast-Real questions from 20 photographed scenes. Evaluations show that closed-source MLLMs outperform general-purpose open-weight MLLMs and MLLMs designed for spatial reasoning, which remain near chance on the synthetic benchmark, while even strong closed-source models struggle with shadow-length and light-height judgments. We also use SpatialCast training data for GRPO post-training, improving open-weight MLLM performance on the benchmark. Further evaluations show improvements on several external spatial benchmarks, suggesting transfer of the learned capabilities. These experiments support SpatialCast as a controlled resource for diagnosing spatial reasoning capabilities and studying their learning and generalization.
